title: Customer Support Specialist | Shopify Dropshipping Experience Required
description:
We run several online women’s fashion stores serving customers in Canada, Australia and Europe. We are looking for a full-time customer support specialist with direct experience handling customer emails for a Shopify dropshipping store.



Previous Shopify dropshipping customer support experience is required. Experience with women’s fashion dropshipping stores is strongly preferred.



ABOUT THE JOB

Our system prepares most customer replies using approved templates. You are the human check: you read the conversation, compare the reply with the order details and tracking, correct errors according to our written policies, and send the right answer.

You also follow up with our fulfilment partner when orders are delayed or something goes wrong. We provide training on our systems and policies, but you should already understand the everyday customer service challenges of dropshipping.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY

- Check and send customer replies about orders, delivery delays, sizing, returns and address changes.

- Verify order details, tracking updates, dates and amounts before sending.

- Follow up on delayed orders and problem cases with our fulfilment partner throughDiscord

- Ask customers for photos or additional information when needed.

- Follow our written policies and flag cases that need an owner’s decision.

- Keep clear case notes and follow up until each issue is resolved.

- Make sure no customer email waits longer than 24 hours for a response.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 1 year of customer support experience with Shopify dropshipping stores.

- Women’s fashion dropshipping experience is a strong advantage.

- Excellent written English.

- Experience handling shipping delays, tracking issues, sizing complaints, returns and refund requests.

- Strong attention to detail: you notice incorrect dates, amounts, products and tracking statuses.

- A calm, professional approach to upset customers.

- Ability to follow written procedures and work reliably without constant supervision.

- Stable internet, your own laptop and a quiet place to work.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Full time: 8 hours per day, at least 6 days per week.

- $4 USD per hour, approximately $830 per month based on 48 hours per week.

- Long-term position with training through written guides and videos.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with KIWI and answer every question below:

1. Which Shopify dropshipping stores have you worked for? Include the store names, website URLs, your role and the dates you worked there.

2. Did any of these stores sell women’s fashion? Which ones?

3. What customer support tasks did you personally handle, which tools did you use, and approximately how many tickets did you handle per day?

4. Describe one difficult customer case you personally resolved involving a delayed order, sizing complaint or return. What did you check, what action did you take, and what was the outcome?

5. Confirm that you are available for the schedule and hourly rate above. Include your time zone and earliest start date.



If a confidentiality agreement prevents you from naming a store, explain this and suggest another way to verify your experience. Please do not share customer information or confidential company records.

We will only consider applications that answer these questions and demonstrate relevant Shopify dropshipping customer support experience. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short practical assessment using fictional customer cases and our written policies.

title: AI CONTENT CREATOR & VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Hey 👋



I run an AI content agency. We make short form video using AI avatars, built with Veo and Flow, for our own brands and for clients across a few different markets.



Let me be honest about who I’m looking for



I’m not looking for someone who wants a job. I’m looking for someone who actually cares about the work.



The difference shows up fast. People who are just here for the money do the minimum, ignore feedback, and plateau. People who care get obsessed with why one video hits and another doesn’t, and they get better every single week.



I already have creators like that. They’re brilliant, they push each other, and they’ve built something I’m proud of. I’m only adding people who raise that standard, not dilute it.



If that sounds intense, it probably isn’t for you. If it sounds like what you’ve been looking for, keep reading.



What you’d actually do



Create short form videos using AI avatars, working from prompts and guides I provide.



Each video takes around an hour once you’re up to speed. The minimum is 2 videos a day per account, which works out at 14 a week. Finish them early and the rest of your week is yours.



What you get that you won’t get elsewhere



I share everything. Prompts, techniques, what’s working, what’s failing. I make the videos myself first so I hit the problems before you do.



We pioneer content in this space, so there’s often a new style to learn week to week. You’ll be building skills that barely exist in the market yet.



And you’ll be alongside creators who are genuinely good. That matters more than people realise.



The one fixed commitment



Sunday group calls, 7 PM Philippines time, every week. That’s where I give feedback and we level up together. It’s the single biggest reason our standard keeps climbing, so it isn’t optional.



What I need from you



Coachable. I give real feedback and we run proper revisions. If criticism stings rather than motivates, this won’t work.



Communicative. If you’re stuck, tell me. Don’t disappear and don’t guess.



Reliable. If you say it’s coming, it comes.



Quality over volume. I’d rather have one great video than three rushed ones.



The pay will be 3$ an hour as most videos takes around that time to make whilst learning new process and techniques, after a while the time frame should shrink within 30-45mins to make.



I’m telling you this early so nobody wastes their time.



How to apply



Tell me, in your own words:



- Why AI content genuinely interests you, not a textbook answer.

Something you’ve made with AI tools, even if it’s rough. Link it



- What you’re currently working on and how many hours you could commit



- How you handle feedback when someone tells you your work isn’t good enough yet

title: Content & Publishing Operations Assistant
description:
We are a British publishing company looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented person to join our publishing team.



You will help create and prepare books for Amazon KDP, working across research, content, editing, design and quality control.



This is not a basic data-entry or copy-and-paste VA role. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with content, technology and AI and wants to develop into a professional publishing role.



Responsibilities

Research book topics, competitors and markets

Assist with book creation and content development

Proofread and quality-check manuscripts

Use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI tools

Check AI-assisted content for errors and quality

Assist with Canva, book covers and A+ Content

Prepare books for Amazon KDP

Check metadata and book listings

Organise files, projects and deadlines

Follow SOPs and quality-control processes

Identify problems and suggest improvements



Requirements:



Excellent written English

Strong attention to detail

Good research and organisational skills

Comfortable using AI tools and learning new software

Able to work independently

Takes constructive feedback professionally

Learns from mistakes and improves

Reliable and interested in a long-term position

Previous publishing, writing, editing, proofreading, content or KDP experience is an advantage



KDP experience is NOT essential — training will be provided to the right person.



Application Questions



Please answer ALL questions:



1. Content/Publishing: What relevant experience do you have with writing, editing, proofreading, publishing, research or content creation?



2. AI: Which AI tools do you currently use and what do you use them for?



3. Quality Control: Tell me about a time you found an important mistake that someone else had missed.



4. Learning: Tell me about a time you received feedback or made a mistake at work. What did you change afterwards?



5. Problem Solving: If you noticed a problem that wasn't included in your instructions, what would you do?



6. KDP: Do you have any Amazon or ecom experience? If yes, explain exactly what you have done.



7. Availability: Confirm you can work 40 hours/week, 4pm–12am Philippines time.



Please provide:



Resume/CV: Open link that can be viewed without requesting access.



Portfolio/work samples: Open link to relevant writing, editing, publishing, design, ecom or other work.



Current employment: Are you currently working for another employer/client?



Only candidates who answer all questions and provide accessible CV/portfolio links will be considered.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to develop their skills and take increasing responsibility within a growing publishing business.

title: AI Video Editor: Long-Form AI Ads (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
We’re a fast-growing US supplement brand running ads on Meta, TikTok, Amazon and TV. Most of our winning ads right now are long-form AI videos: drama stories, songs and Pixar-style animation. We need editors who can make them fast and well.



WHAT YOU NEED

- DTC ad experience. You know an ad exists to sell. You understand hooks, retention, pacing, how to show a problem and its payoff, and why the first 3 seconds d
 everything.

- Visuals that match the words. Every line of the script gets the visual that sells it best. You can’t fill a scene with something random just because it looks nice. And no AI slop: no warped faces or hands, and no characters who change from shot to shot.



THE JOB

- One AI-heavy video per day, up to 5 minutes long.

- 24-hour turnaround from brief to first cut.

- Revisions back the same day.

- You work in our Higgsfield account. We pay for all credits.

- Our creative strategists write every brief and script. You just make the video.



HOW WE WORK

- Transparency and honesty. We say things straight, both good and bad. If something is off, you’ll hear it from us directly, and we expect the same from you. Nobody talks behind anyone’s back.

- Respect. Everyone on the team gets treated with respect, every time.

- Solution focus. When you hit a problem, come with a few ways to fix it, not just the problem.

- Ownership. If it’s your job, it’s your responsibility, from brief to final cut.

- Team spirit. We help each other out. When one of us wins, we all win.



WHAT YOU GET

- Steady daily volume and long-term work.

- A bonus every time one of your ads becomes a winner.

- Access to the newest AI models as they come out.

- A path into creative strategy if you show you understand why ads win.



HOW TO APPLY

There are no calls or interviews. We hire on your application alone, so make it count.



1. Portfolio: links to long-form ads you made recently, 5–10 minutes each, in AI drama, AI song or Pixar-style formats. Send only that kind of work. Short clips, reels and YouTube edits will be skipped.

2. Loom video (2–3 min max):

   - A short summary of your experience.

   - Why you’re the best fit for this role.

   - Show a video you made recently and explain why you chose the visual you used for its hook.

3. Answer these in writing:

   - Which brands have you made ads for? Why did you leave each one?

   - How many credits do you usually use on a 5-minute AI-heavy video?

   - Which models do you use, and for what (characters, scenes, lip-sync, music)?

   - How much do you want to earn per month (USD)?



Applications missing any of the above won’t be reviewed.

title: Medical Receptionist - U.S. Healthcare (Remote)
description:
Role: Medical Receptionist (U.S. Healthcare)



Work Arrangement:

- Fully remote, full-time.

- Availability during U.S. business hours.

- 3+ years of experience in U.S. healthcare.



About the Role:

One of SnappyCX's U.S.-based healthcare clients is looking for an experienced Medical Receptionist to support front-office operations and patient communication. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in a U.S. medical practice, clinic, hospital or outpatient healthcare setting and is fluent in English. This is a patient-facing medical reception role. Candidates whose experience is limited to general customer service or call center roles, without medical reception or healthcare experience, may not be considered.



Key Responsibilities:

- Answer inbound patient calls in English.

- Schedule, reschedule and cancel patient appointments.

- Register patients and update demographic information.

- Manage patient messages, follow-ups and administrative requests.

- Enter and maintain accurate patient information in the EMR/EHR.

- Verify insurance eligibility and benefits when required.

- Handle incoming and outgoing faxes and patient communications.

- Route clinical questions and provider-related requests appropriately.

- Maintain patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA requirements.



Requirements:

- 3+ years of experience in U.S. healthcare.

- Previous experience as a Medical Receptionist, Medical Front Desk or similar healthcare role.

- Experience working directly with patients in a U.S. healthcare setting.

- Fluent in English, spoken and written, with a clear, neutral accent.

- Experience with patient scheduling and registration.

- Experience using an EMR/EHR system.

- Strong communication, organization and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

- Availability to work during required U.S. business hours.

- At least 2 employment references. Reference checks with previous employers are required before hiring.



Preferred:

- Insurance eligibility and benefits verification experience.

- Experience handling high-volume patient calls.

- Experience with EMR/EHR platforms such as Athenahealth, Tebra, eClinicalWorks, Practice Fusion, Epic, SimplePractice or similar systems.

- Previous remote experience supporting U.S. healthcare practices.



Technical Requirements:

- Desktop or laptop computer with a headset.

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace.



How to Apply:

- Include "Medical Receptionist" in the first line of your application.

- List the U.S. practices or clinics you have supported and the EMR/EHR systems you have used.

- Attach your resume.

- Be ready to provide contact details for at least 2 previous employers for reference checks.

title: Senior E-commerce Web Developer
description:
🚀 WE'RE HIRING: Senior E-commerce Web Developer | Shopify, Funnelish, Checkout Champ, AI Automation & Meta/Google Ads



Job Type: Full-Time / Long-Term  

Work Location: Remote 

Experience Level: Senior / Expert



## About the Role



We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company looking for a highly experienced Senior E-commerce Web Developer with advanced expertise in Shopify, sales funnels, conversion rate optimization, AI automation, and digital advertising platforms.



We are NOT looking for a basic web developer, graphic designer, or someone who only knows how to use Shopify.



We need a true all-around e-commerce expert who can independently manage the entire technical and commercial ecosystem of an online store: from product pages and sales funnels to checkout optimization, post-purchase offers, automations, and advertising integrations.



The ideal candidate must have extensive knowledge of advanced e-commerce tools, execute tasks extremely quickly, and proactively identify opportunities to increase sales, conversions, and profitability.



Speed, independence, technical expertise, problem-solving, and execution are essential.



## 📌 Key Responsibilities



### 1. Shopify – Advanced Expertise



- Build, customize, manage, and optimize Shopify stores.

- Develop high-converting landing pages and product pages.

- Work with Shopify, PageFly, and other professional page builders.

- Customize Shopify themes, sections, and store functionality.

- Configure products, bundles, discounts, promotions, and special offers.

- Integrate third-party applications and external tools.

- Optimize website speed, mobile experience, and conversion rates.

- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues quickly.

- Implement custom functionality using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when necessary.



### 2. Funnelish & Checkout Champ – Advanced Funnel Development



We are specifically looking for someone with strong practical experience using Funnelish and Checkout Champ.



Responsibilities include:



- Building complete, high-converting sales funnels.

- Creating conversion-focused landing pages.

- Setting up and optimizing checkout pages.

- Implementing order bumps, upsells, downsells, and cross-sells.

- Building one-click post-purchase offers.

- Creating and optimizing post-purchase pages.

- Configuring funnels with multiple offers, bundles, and pricing strategies.

- Integrating funnels with Shopify and payment processors.

- Setting up tracking, conversion events, and attribution.

- Running A/B tests to improve funnel performance.

- Identifying and fixing checkout and funnel issues.



You must understand the complete customer journey, from the first ad click to checkout, purchase, and post-purchase offers.



### 3. AI Tools, Automation & Rapid Development



- Use AI-powered tools to build websites, landing pages, and funnels significantly faster.

- Create automations to streamline e-commerce operations.

- Work with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Make, n8n, Zapier, or equivalent platforms.

- Build integrations between Shopify, CRM systems, advertising platforms, and other business tools.

- Develop custom dashboards and internal business applications.

- Automate repetitive tasks and operational workflows.

- Use AI-assisted coding and development tools to accelerate execution.

- Identify opportunities to replace manual processes with reliable automations.



We want someone who genuinely knows how to leverage AI to execute projects much faster, not someone who simply uses ChatGPT to generate text.



### 4. Meta Business Manager & Google Ads



The candidate must have strong knowledge of digital advertising platforms, particularly:



Meta Business Manager / Meta Ads



- Manage Meta Business Manager and advertising accounts.

- Configure Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI).

- Set up events, domain verification, and conversion tracking.

- Create, configure, and manage advertising campaigns.

- Understand Sales, retargeting, and prospecting campaigns.

- Analyze advertising performance and campaign metrics.

- Troubleshoot tracking issues, account problems, and integration errors.



Google Ads



- Set up and manage Google Ads accounts.

- Understand Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns.

- Configure and manage Google Merchant Center.

- Implement conversion tracking.

- Integrate Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager.

- Analyze ROAS, CPA, CPC, and other performance metrics.

- Identify tracking issues and optimization opportunities.



We are not necessarily looking for a dedicated media buyer. We need an e-commerce expert who understands advertising platforms, can work with campaigns independently, and can correctly manage all technical integrations and tracking systems.



### 5.
 Marketing & Customer Retention



- Build automated
 marketing campaigns and flows.

- Set up abandoned cart and abandoned checkout recovery sequences.

- Create post-purchase
 automations.

- Implement upsell and cross-sell
 campaigns.

- Build customer segmentation and retention workflows.

- Work with Klaviyo, Shopify
, or similar platforms.



### 6. Analytics, Profit & Loss Dashboards



- Build custom dashboards to monitor e-commerce performance.

- Integrate data from Shopify, Meta Ads, and Google Ads.

- Track revenue, advertising expenses, product costs, and shipping costs.

- Calculate profit margins, ROAS, CPA, and overall profitability.

- Create automated reporting systems.

- Monitor inventory levels and product availability.

- Develop internal tools to improve business decision-making.



### 7. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)



- Analyze and improve website conversion rates.

- Optimize product pages, landing pages, and checkout experiences.

- Identify friction points and drop-offs throughout the sales funnel.

- Implement A/B testing.

- Improve Average Order Value (AOV), conversion rate, and revenue per visitor.

- Proactively suggest improvements based on performance data.



## 🎯 Essential Requirements



- Extensive, proven experience in the e-commerce industry.

- Expert-level Shopify knowledge.

- Hands-on experience with Funnelish and/or Checkout Champ, ideally both.

- Strong experience building advanced sales funnels and post-purchase offers.

- Excellent knowledge of Meta Business Manager and Google Ads.

- Ability to configure pixels, conversion events, tracking systems, and integrations.

- Strong experience with AI development tools and automation platforms.

- Knowledge of
 marketing and customer retention systems.

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Excellent technical problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Strong communication skills and reliable availability.

- Extremely fast execution without sacrificing quality.



We care much more about real-world skills, completed projects, measurable results, and execution speed than degrees or certifications.



## 🔥 The Ideal Candidate



We do not want someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every task.



We are looking for someone who can receive an objective and independently:



- Identify the best technical solution.

- Select the most effective tools.

- Build and implement the project quickly.

- Test everything thoroughly.

- Deliver complete, professional, and functional results.

- Proactively recommend improvements to increase performance.



Our goal is to hire a highly specialized Senior E-commerce Web Developer who becomes the main technical and operational expert for our entire e-commerce ecosystem.



## 📩 How to Apply



To be considered, you must answer ALL the following questions



1. E-commerce Experience



How many years have you worked in e-commerce? Which brands or companies have you worked with?



2. Shopify Expertise



Rate your Shopify skills from 1 to 10. Share at least 2–3 Shopify stores or pages you personally developed.



3. Funnelish & Checkout Champ



Have you worked with Funnelish or Checkout Champ? Which platform do you know best? Share real examples of funnels you have built.



4. Post-Purchase Funnels



Do you have experience creating upsells, downsells, order bumps, and one-click post-purchase offers? Which tools have you used?



5. Meta Business Manager



What is your experience level with Meta Business Manager? Can you configure Meta Pixel, Conversions API, events, and advertising campaigns?



6. Google Ads



Do you have experience with Google Ads, Merchant Center, GA4, and Google Tag Manager? Have you configured or managed Search, Shopping, or Performance Max campaigns?



7. Artificial Intelligence



Which AI tools do you use daily? Share specific examples of websites, automations, dashboards, or applications you have built using AI.



8.
 Marketing



Which
 marketing platforms have you worked with? Have you built automated flows for abandoned checkouts, post-purchase sequences, and customer retention?



9. Profit & Loss Dashboards



Have you ever built a dashboard that automatically calculates e-commerce revenue, advertising expenses, operational costs, and net profit?



10. Execution Speed



How long would it realistically take you to:



- Build a complete Shopify landing page?

- Create a sales funnel with checkout, upsells, and downsells?

- Set up a post-purchase funnel?

- Build a fully functional Shopify store?

- Create a P&L dashboard integrated with Shopify and Meta Ads?



11. Availability



How many hours per day and days per week are you available? Can you start immediately?



12. Skills Self-Assessment



Rate your skills from 1 to 10 in each of the following areas:



- Shopify

- Funnelish

- Checkout Champ

- Landing Pages & CRO

- Meta Business Manager

- Google Ads

- AI Website Building

- AI Automation

-
 Marketing

- Analytics & P&L Dashboards



13. Compensation



What is your expected monthly salary in USD for a full-time position?



14. Why Should We Hire You?



Explain what makes you more skilled, faster, and more effective than other candidates. Provide concrete examples of your work and achievements.



## ⚠️ Important



**This position is strictly for professionals with advanced, proven e-commerce experience.**



We are not looking for beginners, generic web developers, or people who only understand the basic features of Shopify.



We have multiple ongoing projects and are looking for a long-term team member who can take ownership of technical projects, work independently, and directly contribute to our company's growth.



**Please do not submit generic or entirely AI-generated applications without real examples of your work.**



We want to see actual portfolios, working projects, demonstrable technical expertise, and realistic delivery times.



**If you are a true e-commerce expert, have advanced Shopify and funnel-building skills, know how to leverage AI, understand Meta and Google advertising platforms, and can execute extremely quickly, we want to hear from you.**

title: Appointment Setter/Outbound Calling Specialist
description:
Five Star Bath Solutions of Sioux Falls



Remote  |  $5.00 USD/hour + performance bonuses  |  40 hours/week  |  Monday–Friday, 12–8 PM U.S. Central  |  Initial 60-day paid pilot



About Our Company

Five Star Bath Solutions of Sioux Falls is a growing bathroom remodeling company serving homeowners throughout South Dakota, Nebraska, Iowa, and Minnesota. We specialize in walk-in showers, tub-to-shower conversions, and bathtub replacements.



About the Position

 

This is a phone-intensive sales support position—not a general virtual assistant role. We generate approximately 300 new leads per month. Your job is to respond quickly, connect with homeowners, qualify their needs, and schedule appointments. Speed-to-lead is a top priority. Expect approximately 100–200 outbound call attempts daily depending on lead volume and campaign activity.



Primary Responsibilities

• Respond promptly to new leads during working hours, prioritizing speed-to-lead

• Make approximately 100–200 outbound call attempts per day

• Qualify interested homeowners and schedule in-home sales appointments

• Follow up with unresponsive leads, event prospects, and older inquiries

• Confirm appointments and help reduce cancellations and no-shows

• Accurately record call outcomes and customer details in the CRM

• Coordinate appointment information with the sales team

• Track daily activity, contacts, qualified appointments, and appointment attendance

• Follow company procedures and honor opt-out requests



English Communication Requirements:

Exceptional spoken English is essential. Our customers are primarily Midwestern U.S. homeowners. You must speak fluent, easily understood conversational English; listen carefully; build rapport naturally; handle objections without relying entirely on a script; and communicate comfortably with older American homeowners. Prior outbound calling experience with U.S. customers is strongly preferred.



Required Qualifications:

• Proven outbound calling, appointment-setting, telemarketing, or inside-sales experience

• Experience speaking with U.S.-based customers

• Comfortable with high call volume and frequent unanswered calls

• Strong objection-handling, organization, and follow-up skills

• Reliable internet, computer, quality headset, and quiet workspace

• Ability to work Monday–Friday, 12–8 PM U.S. Central, adjusting for daylight saving time

• Familiarity with CRM and calling software; home-services experience is a plus



Compensation and 60-Day Pilot

Pay is $5.00 USD per hour for 40 hours per week, plus performance-based bonus opportunities. Bonus criteria will be discussed during interviews. This is an initial 60-day paid pilot intended to lead to an ongoing full-time role if performance and fit are strong. We will assess reliability, spoken communication, speed-to-lead, call productivity, qualified appointments, appointment attendance, CRM accuracy, and professionalism.



To Apply

1. Describe your outbound calling experience with U.S. customers and what you called about.

2. How many outbound calls did you make per day in your most recent role?

3. What were your typical appointment-setting results? Provide numbers if possible.

4. Can you consistently work Monday–Friday, 12–8 PM U.S. Central?

5. How would you respond to a homeowner who does not remember requesting remodeling information?

6. Required: Submit a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself, describing your experience, and explaining why you are a good fit.

7.     Describe your home office arrangement as well as your technology and internet speed.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates will complete a live interview and simulated customer call.

Responsibilities

Contact Status: Organize interested sellers, not interested, wrong numbers, no responses, and opt-outs, etc.



List Suppression: Remove duplicates and exclude contacts who shouldn't be texted again.

Reporting: Build a simple dashboard showing our records, campaign history, follow-ups, and available prospects.



Ongoing Management: Keep the database updated after each campaign and check existing records before purchasing new data.



Training: Create simple step-by-step instructions and train our team to use the system.



Experience Required



Strong Google Sheets skills, including data cleaning, deduplication, and database management.



Experience importing/exporting large datasets, tracking marketing history, and managing suppression lists.



Experience managing marketing lists and SMS campaigns.



Preferred Experience:



Vacant land investing, land wholesaling, or real estate data management.



Land Portal, Land Insights, PropStream, or similar software.



Smarter Contact/Launch Control or similar SMS marketing platforms.



Who We're Looking For



Someone who can build, organize, and manage our data system with minimal supervision.



All databases, files, and processes must remain in our company's Google Drive under our ownership.



To Apply

title: Video Team Manager & Quality Checker (E-commerce Ads)
description:
We're an e-commerce company running several online stores across Europe. All of our ads are videos made by our in-house team of video editors, and we're looking for a sharp, organised manager to lead one of our editing teams and any other adhoc tasks.



Our editors are split into two teams. You'll manage your own team of 4 editors, while our other manager runs the second team. You'll mainly work independently but also working alongside the AD analyst/product researcher to d
 on what tasks to assign next.



What you'll do:

- Plan your team's work for the next day. Our product researcher and ads analyst will tell you which products need ads and which ads need refreshing, and you d
 what gets made and in what order

- Most of the work is new ads for new products, plus fresh ads for products that are already winning

- Assign video projects to your editors and make sure every deadline is met

- Review every video before it goes live and check it for mistakes: captions, spelling, timing, cuts, music, product shots and overall quality

- Send clear revision notes to your editors and check that every fix is done properly

- Keep track of your editors' hours and overtime

- Upload and publish the finished ads (easy to learn, we'll show you how)



Captions and languages:

Our ads run across Europe, so most of our videos have captions and voiceovers in Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German and Dutch. You don't need to speak these languages, but you need to be very good at comparing captions against the script word for word and spotting anything that doesn't match: missing words, typos, wrong letters (å, ä, ö, ø, æ, ü), captions out of sync or cut off on screen.



This is the most important part of the role. If a mistake gets past you, it goes live in front of thousands of customers.



You should have:

- Management experience: leading a team, planning work, assigning tasks and following up

- Experience with video production or editing, so you know what a good ad looks like and can spot mistakes quickly

- A very keen eye for detail

- E-commerce or social media ads experience is a big plus

- Clear written English, your revision notes need to be easy for editors to follow

- Reliability: you show up every day, stay on top of your team and deliver on time



What we offer:

- $700/month for 4 hours a day, 7 days a week

- A raise after 2–3 months when the work is good

- Monthly bonus based on your team's performance:

  - Few or no mistakes making it into live ads

  - Deadlines met and your team delivering on time

  - Strong, consistent output from your editors

- Reliable, long-term work with flexible hours

- Room to grow into a bigger role as we scale



How to apply:

1. Start your message with "QUALITY CHECK" so we know you read this post

2. Tell us about your management experience: how many people you managed and what the work was

3. Tell us about your experience with video production or editing

4. Portfolio or examples of previous work

title: Freelance News Writer – Whisky news website
description:
Hey!



We are looking for a dedicated freelance whisky news writer for a European whisky website who can produce daily news articles about whisky, distilleries, new releases, and developments in the global whisky industry.



We are seeking someone who can deliver 3 news articles per day, Monday through Friday. The focus is on current, relevant, interesting, and factually accurate whisky news and how to drink articles. 



Topics may include:



New whisky releases and limited editions



Scotch whisky, bourbon, Irish whiskey, Japanese whisky, and world whisky



Distillery news, openings, expansions, and closures



Whisky industry developments and emerging trends



Whisky auctions, rare bottles, and collectibles



Awards, competitions, and major whisky events



Interesting stories about whisky brands and producers



Each news article should take no longer than approximately 30 minutes to research and write.



We also expect you to upload the finished articles to our admin system independently, ensuring they are properly formatted and organized.



You may use ChatGPT to help translate articles into our website's language, but the articles themselves must be written by you. We expect original, human-written content, not AI-generated articles.

Compensation



$3 per article



3 articles per day, Monday through Friday



Approximately $180–$207 per month, depending on the number of working days



This is a starting rate. With strong performance, platform growth, and a successful long-term collaboration, compensation can increase over time.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Has a genuine interest in whisky and understands the whisky industry



Is familiar with different whisky categories, including Scotch, bourbon, Irish whiskey, Japanese whisky, and world whisky



Can write 3 news articles per day from Monday to Friday



Can research and complete each article within approximately 30 minutes



Has a distinctive, engaging, and natural writing style



Produces factually accurate articles and conducts proper research



Can independently identify interesting whisky news from reliable industry sources



Does not rely solely on ChatGPT or other AI tools to generate content



Is fluent in English



Has basic knowledge of SEO, including headings, keywords, and readability



Can upload articles independently and correctly into our admin system



Meets deadlines consistently



Understands the difference between informative journalism and promotional content



The articles must be suitable for an international audience of whisky enthusiasts, from beginners to experienced collectors, and ready for professional publication.



Important – Please Read Before Applying



Unfortunately, we haven't always had the best experiences with freelance writers in the past.



Some applicants claimed to have experience with whisky or a strong understanding of the industry, but once the collaboration started, it became clear that their actual knowledge was quite limited.



We want to avoid this situation moving forward.



We are not necessarily looking for a certified whisky expert, but we do expect genuine interest, basic industry knowledge, and a willingness to stay informed about developments in the whisky world.



If you are seriously interested in this position, please explain why YOU believe you are the right candidate for this role.



What makes you different from other applicants? Why should we trust you to deliver accurate, interesting, and well-researched whisky news consistently?



We appreciate honest answers much more than exaggerated claims about experience.



Our Policy on AI-Generated Content



We are not looking for copy-paste work or fully AI-generated articles.



AI tools may be used to support research, translation, or article structuring, but the finished articles must clearly reflect a human writing style.



All information must be factually accurate, properly researched, and based on reliable sources.



We value writers who can turn whisky industry announcements and press releases into engaging, original news articles rather than simply rewriting promotional material.



If your approach is to copy a press release into ChatGPT and publish the result without proper research, this position is not for you.



What You Can Expect



A consistent monthly collaboration



Growth opportunities based on performance



The opportunity to become part of our growing editorial team



The chance to develop your knowledge of the international whisky industry



Potential expansion into whisky reviews, distillery features, interviews, buying guides, and special reports



A long-term working relationship if the collaboration is successful



Application



Interested?



Please send us:



2 to 3 examples of previously written articles, preferably in English



A short explanation of your writing experience and knowledge of whisky



Any SEO experience you may have



Your availability



Your connection to or interest in the whisky industry



Any experience writing about spirits, drinks, lifestyle, or related industries



A personal explanation of why you believe you are the right person for this position



We are particularly interested in hearing about your genuine connection to whisky. Whether you enjoy exploring different distilleries, following new releases, collecting bottles, or simply keeping up with whisky industry news, we want to know what makes this subject interesting to you.



One Final Question



To show us that you have carefully read this entire job description, please tell us what your favorite type of whisky glass is and why you prefer it.





Applications that do not answer this question may not be considered.



We look forward to building a long-term collaboration with someone who genuinely enjoys the world of whisky, takes their work seriously, understands the importance of accurate reporting, and values high-quality content.



We are looking for reliability, genuine interest, and quality — not just someone who can produce articles quickly.

title: Growth & Operations Manager — Australian Construction SaaS (Sales, GoHighLevel, Marketing)
description:
Buildops Systems Pty Ltd is seeking an experienced remote contractor to help launch and grow two software brands serving the Australian building industry: a construction CRM and a construction project-management tool. You will work directly with the owner and take ownership of marketing, sales and customer delivery, then help build and manage a team as the brands grow. This is a senior, hands-on role — not an entry-level VA position.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Cold call prospects, run software demos, follow up on enquiries and close sales using approved offers.

- Build and manage GoHighLevel campaigns, pipelines, forms and automations.

- Create social content and videos, landing pages and paid ad campaigns; report results and spend.

- Configure customer CRM accounts, onboard and train customers, and provide first-line support.

- Assess both brands and propose launch priorities, targets and a marketing budget for approval.

- Recruit and assess future team members for approval, then manage their daily delivery and quality.

- Report weekly against agreed targets, keep accurate records and take responsibility for solving problems.



WHAT YOU MUST BRING (please give specific examples of your own results)

- Cold calling and outbound sales to business owners/decision-makers, in fluent, confident spoken English.

- Running software demos and converting prospects to paying customers.

- Paid advertising with measurable results (Meta/Google) — budgets, leads, conversions you can point to.

- Launching or growing a software subscription (SaaS) business.

- GoHighLevel experience — building campaigns, pipelines, automations and dashboards.

- Sales management and client account management / onboarding.

- Exceptional spoken and written English, strong problem-solving, and the ability to own marketing, sales and customer delivery end-to-end with minimal supervision.

- Leadership / managing remote people is a plus. Construction or trades industry experience is a bonus, not required. Product training does not replace the essential skills for this role.



ENGAGEMENT

- Starts at ~20 hours per week, long-term, with a performance and rate review at three months (no guaranteed increase).

- Flexible delivery around agreed meetings and Australian (Perth / AWST) customer appointments.

- Weekly invoicing; payment weekly. Other clients are acceptable outside agreed commitments.

- Time tracking with Trackabi (task descriptions + activity screenshots) is required.

- You must have your own computer, reliable internet with a backup, a power-outage contingency, a quiet workspace, and a quality headset and webcam.

- One-off signup bonuses apply for eligible new customers you personally sign up (full rules provided to shortlisted applicants).



HOW TO APPLY

In your application, please include:

1. A short introduction and your earliest start date and weekly availability (in Perth/AWST time).

2. Your answers to these questions, with specific examples and measurable results:

   - Describe a software subscription (SaaS) business you helped launch or grow — the starting point, what YOU did, and the paying customers or revenue that resulted.

   - Give one cold-calling / sales example where you personally progressed a prospect to payment. What did you say and do?

   - Describe one paid ad campaign you ran — platform, budget, leads, and paying customers — and how you measured attribution.

   - Describe a GoHighLevel workflow you built (triggers, follow-up, stop rules).

3. Two work samples (marketing/video content and sales/operational delivery) using links that can be viewed without requesting access.



Shortlisted applicants complete a short recorded screening interview; the strongest candidates progress to a live second-round interview with the owner. Please redact any confidential client information.

title: HIRING: Experienced Faceless YouTube Creators | Multiple Niches | $8 Per Video + View Bonuses | Long-Term Opportunity
description:
We're looking for experienced, independent Faceless YouTube Creators to join our growing team!



We own and operate multiple YouTube channels, most of which are already monetized. We're looking for talented creators who understand how to produce high-quality faceless YouTube videos that actually generate views.



Ideally, we're looking for someone who can handle the ENTIRE video production process independently — from scriptwriting to voice-over, editing, and thumbnails.



We want someone who understands YouTube, knows what makes videos successful, and can work independently without needing constant instructions.



This is a long-term opportunity with performance-based bonuses and the potential to grow alongside our channels.



Our YouTube Niches



We currently operate channels in the following niches:



🏎️ Formula 1 (F1)



🏆 Sports



🔪 True Crime / Murder Mysteries



🌊 Ocean & Marine Life



When applying, please tell us which niche you prefer working in and why.



You can choose multiple niches, but please mention your first choice.



What We're Looking For



Ideally, you can handle the complete faceless YouTube production process independently.



This includes:



Scriptwriting: Researching topics and writing engaging scripts with strong hooks, storytelling, and audience retention in mind.



Voice-over: Recording your own natural, high-quality English voice-over, preferably with an American or British accent.



Video Editing: Creating professional faceless YouTube videos with engaging visuals, excellent pacing, smooth transitions, and sound effects.



Visual Sourcing: Finding relevant footage, images, and other visuals that can legally be used in monetized YouTube videos.



Thumbnail Creation: Designing attractive, clickable thumbnails that help improve CTR.



YouTube Optimization: Understanding audience retention, watch time, CTR, and what makes YouTube videos successful.



Independent Workflow: Managing the production process from start to finish with minimal supervision.



Our ideal candidate can take a video idea and turn it into a complete, publication-ready YouTube video.



We value people who take initiative, solve problems independently, and genuinely understand how successful faceless YouTube channels operate.



EXPERIENCE & PROVEN RESULTS ARE EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



We are specifically looking for people with real experience creating faceless YouTube content.



We don't just want to hear that you're experienced. We want to SEE proof.



Anyone can claim to have worked on successful YouTube channels. That's why we require actual evidence of your previous work and results.



What Proof Do We Require?



Please provide screenshots showing results from YouTube channels you've previously worked on.



Examples include:



Screenshots from YouTube Studio showing video views and performance.



Screenshots showing channel growth or subscriber growth.



Screenshots showing revenue or monetization results.



Screenshots showing CTR, audience retention, or watch time.



Other verifiable evidence demonstrating the results of your work.



You are absolutely allowed to blur or hide the channel name and any sensitive information.



We respect your privacy and confidentiality.



However, screenshots must be genuine, and you must be able to explain exactly what you contributed to those results.



We may request additional verification during the selection process to confirm your experience.



Applications with actual proof of experience and results will receive priority.



We're much more interested in what you've actually achieved than in how many years you claim to have been working.



IMPORTANT: Can't Do Everything? STILL APPLY!



Although we prefer someone who can handle the complete production process, you do NOT need to be perfect at everything to apply.



For example:



Are you an exceptional video editor but can't record your own voice-over? APPLY!



Are you great at scriptwriting and storytelling but don't create thumbnails? APPLY!



Are you excellent at voice-overs but don't edit videos? APPLY!



Are you highly experienced with faceless YouTube channels but specialize in only certain parts of production? APPLY!



We have multiple channels and different production needs.



If you're exceptionally good at something and can prove your results, we definitely want to hear from you.



Just be honest about what you can and cannot do.



We value proven skills and results much more than someone claiming to be an expert at everything.



Long-Term Opportunity & Payment



Base payment: $8 per video + performance-based bonuses!



We are looking for people who want to build something long-term.



Our starting rate is $8 per completed video, with additional bonuses when videos reach certain view milestones.



The better your videos perform, the more you can earn!



Most of our YouTube channels are already monetized, and our goal is to grow them significantly.



We understand that the starting rate is low, but we offer the opportunity to grow alongside our channels.



What we offer:



$8 base payment per completed video



Extra bonuses when videos reach specific view milestones



Potential for higher rates as channels grow



Consistent, long-term work across multiple channels



Opportunities to take on more responsibility and earn more



Bonus milestones and rewards will be discussed and agreed upon before starting.



We believe in rewarding results. If your videos consistently generate strong views and help our channels grow, we want to reward that success.



When our channels grow, we want YOU to grow with us.



We're not looking for someone who just completes tasks. We're looking for someone who wants to help build successful YouTube channels and share in that success.



We Value Independent Creators



One of the most important things we're looking for is INDEPENDENCE.



We don't want to explain every small detail or constantly supervise the production process.



We want someone who:



Understands what makes a successful YouTube video.



Can research topics and come up with creative ideas.



Can make decisions independently.



Takes responsibility for the quality of their work.



Understands the importance of deadlines and consistency.



Knows how to create content that keeps viewers watching.



Actively looks for ways to improve video performance.



Communicates clearly and reliably.



The less supervision you need while consistently delivering excellent results, the better.



We want to build a team of people who genuinely understand YouTube and take ownership of their work.



How to Apply — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



To be considered, please answer the following questions.



1. Which niche do you prefer?



Choose your preferred channel:



Formula 1 (F1)



Sports



True Crime / Murder Mysteries



Ocean & Marine Life



You may select multiple niches, but please tell us your first choice and why.



2. What can you do independently?



Tell us which parts of the production process you can handle:



Research and scriptwriting



Human voice-over



Video editing



Footage and visual sourcing



Thumbnail creation



Complete video production



Be honest. You don't need to be able to do everything.



3. What experience do you have with faceless YouTube channels?



Explain which channels you've worked on, what your responsibilities were, and what results you achieved.



Have you previously worked on monetized YouTube channels?



4. PROVIDE SCREENSHOTS OF YOUR RESULTS (VERY IMPORTANT)



This is one of the most important parts of your application.



Attach screenshots from YouTube Studio or other credible evidence showing the actual performance of channels or videos you've worked on.



We are especially interested in:



Video views



Channel growth



Audience retention



CTR



Revenue or monetization performance



You may blur channel names and sensitive details.



We understand that some creators work under confidentiality agreements.



However, we want genuine proof that you have experience and know how to create videos that perform.



We want proof, not just claims.



5. Show us your previous work.



Provide links to at least 2–3 videos you've personally created, edited, scripted, or voiced.



Clearly explain your role in each video.



6. Can you record your own English voice-over?



If yes, please include a sample of your natural speaking voice.



If not, that's completely fine. Just tell us.



7. Are you comfortable with our payment structure?



Our starting payment is $8 per video + performance-based bonuses when videos reach certain view milestones.



Please confirm whether you're comfortable with this structure and explain which parts of the production process you can handle for this rate.



8. How do you handle copyright and footage sourcing?



Explain how you find footage and visuals that can legally be used in monetized YouTube videos.



This is especially important for our F1, sports, and true crime channels.



We want to understand how you avoid copyright claims, strikes, and monetization problems.



9. Why should we choose you?



Tell us what makes you different, what results you've achieved, and how you could help our channels grow.



10. Do you have experience with VidRush?



Please let us know whether you have previously worked with VidRush.



If yes, briefly explain how you've used it and what your experience has been.



Experience with VidRush is a plus, but it's not required.



One Last Thing



We care about 3 things above everything else:



1. Proven experience.



2. Real, verifiable results.



3. The ability to work independently and deliver quality.



You don't need to be the best at every part of YouTube production.



But you do need to be genuinely good at what you do, and ideally, you should be able to prove it.



We're serious about growing our channels, and we're looking for equally serious people who want to become part of that journey.



If you're a talented video editor, scriptwriter, voice-over artist, or complete faceless YouTube creator, we encourage you to apply — even if you don't meet every single requirement.



We have multiple channels, long-term ambitions, and opportunities for the right people.



The better our videos perform, the more opportunities there will be for you to earn and grow.



We're looking for a long-term partnership, not just someone to complete a few videos.



If you're experienced, reliable, independent, and motivated to grow with us, we'd love to hear from you!



Let's build successful YouTube channels together!

title: Senior AI & Automation Systems Engineer
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING.  SPAM APPLICATIONS WILL BE IGNORED.



Job Title:  Senior AI & Automation Systems Engineer (Full-Stack Data, Workflows & Browser Agents)



Role Type: Full-Time / Contract-to-Hire (Remote)



About the Role



We are building an end-to-end automated job discovery, AI resume tailoring, and autonomous application platform. We are looking for a Senior AI & Automation Systems Engineer to own, architect, and build out our core 6-phase technical pipeline from the ground up.



You will be responsible for connecting multi-source data ingestion feeds, designing relational and vector database architectures, orchestrating complex LLM evaluation loops, and building resilient headless browser agents capable of navigating and submitting applications across diverse Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) with human-in-the-loop fallbacks.



What You Will Build (The 6-Phase Architecture)



 Phase 1: High-Volume Job Ingestion & Normalization Pipeline



 ●Architect scheduled hourly pulls and real-time push webhooks in self-hosted n8n from 10+ job data vendors and scraping fleets (TheirStack, CoreSignal, Bright Data, Apify, JobDataAPI, LinkdAPI, PredictLeads, Crustdata, Techmap, Hirebase, Grepsr). 

 ●Write custom JavaScript normalization logic to standardize schemas and automatically detect ATS platforms. 

 ●Implement sliding-window deduplication via Upstash Redis, persist structured job data in Supabase (PostgreSQL), generate embeddings (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small + LangChain) into Qdrant Cloud, and archive raw JSON batches to Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3. 



 Phases 2 & 3: AI Resume Tailoring & ATS Scoring Engine



 ●Build iterative LLM workflows (OpenAI GPT-4o / GPT-4o-mini) that pull user profile data, tailor resumes and cover letters without hallucination, and run automated ATS match scoring loops (0–100%) until quality thresholds (≥90%) are met. 

 ●Store generated PDF/DOCX assets in Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3. 



 Phases 4 & 5: Autonomous Browser Observation & Auto-Apply



 ●Develop cloud headless browser automation using Stagehand Engine, Browserbase, and Playwright to render job application pages, inspect DOM structures, and map form fields. 

 ●Implement AI field-matching against a user knowledge base with confidence scoring (≥95%) before autonomously filling inputs, attaching tailored resumes, submitting applications, and verifying success DOM states. 



 Phase 6: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) & Fallback Queues



 ●Build stateful pause/resume workflows (using n8n Wait nodes, RabbitMQ, and internal dashboard APIs/Appsmith) that prompt users when field confidence is low or submissions fail. 

 ●Capture user corrections to dynamically update the Supabase user knowledge base and re-trigger browser sessions, routing edge cases to a manual review queue. 



Required Skills & Technical Experience



 Workflow Orchestration & Backend Engineering:



 ●Deep hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and extending n8n (self-hosted), including complex branching, webhook handling, custom JavaScript nodes, error handling, and long-running Wait states. 

 ●Strong proficiency in Node.js / TypeScript and Python for building core APIs, data loaders, and custom microservices.



 Database Architecture & Data Engineering:



 ●PostgreSQL (Supabase): Schema design, indexing, upserts, and high-throughput transactional logging. 

 ●Vector Databases & Search: Production experience with Qdrant (or Pinecone/Weaviate), LangChain, and OpenAI embedding models for semantic job matching. 

 ●Caching, Queues & Object Storage: Experience with Redis (Upstash) for deduplication/caching, message brokers (RabbitMQ), and S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3). 



 AI / LLM Engineering:



 ●Proven track record building deterministic, structured-output LLM pipelines using the OpenAI API. 

 ●Experience designing prompt chains with self-correction loops, strict anti-hallucination guardrails, and confidence scoring. 



 Headless Browser & Web Automation:



 ●Strong background in browser automation using Playwright, Puppeteer, Browserbase, and AI-native browser frameworks like Stagehand. 

 ●Familiarity with anti-bot evasion, proxy rotation, dynamic DOM parsing, and handling complex multi-step forms across major ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, etc.).



Nice-to-Have Qualifications



 ●Experience integrating with B2B data aggregators and scraping platforms (Bright Data, Apify, CoreSignal, TheirStack). 

 ●Familiarity with low-code internal tooling (e.g., Appsmith) and Notion API integrations. 

 ●Prior experience in HR-tech, recruiting platforms, or high-volume data ingestion startups.



How to Apply



Please share:



 ●Your GitHub profile, portfolio, or links to complex automation/AI systems you have architected.

 ●A brief overview of a production pipeline you built involving n8n (or similar orchestrators), vector/relational databases, or headless browser automation.

 ●Your availability and expected compensation.

        ●After you submit your resume/application, send me a message using this Subject line: "Go big or go home."  Otherwise, your application will be ignored.

title: Creative Marketing Assistant | Luxury Cinematic Video Editor — Part-Time
description:
CREATIVE MARKETING ASSISTANT | LUXURY CINEMATIC VIDEO EDITOR



Company: The Royal Cup

Compensation: $5 USD/hour

Weekly Budget: Up to $35 USD

Hours: Up to 7 authorized hours weekly

Schedule: Consistent, preapproved production blocks

Employment: Long-term, part-time

Evaluation: Three-week paid evaluation



READ BEFORE APPLYING — MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS



This position is for an experienced cinematic video editor who already possesses the technical skills and creative judgment to produce luxury-quality content.



This is NOT an entry-level editing position or a general virtual assistant role.



Apply ONLY if you meet ALL requirements below:



- CAPCUT PRO: You currently have your own active, paid CapCut Pro subscription.

- CANVA PRO: You currently have your own active, paid Canva Pro subscription.

- ADVANCED EDITING: You are proficient in cinematic speed ramping, keyframe animation, masking, motion graphics, sophisticated transitions, color grading, audio synchronization, and refined typography.

- LUXURY PORTFOLIO: You have existing, personally edited videos demonstrating cinematic quality comparable to the references below.

- INDEPENDENT TOOLS: You already possess the required software, subscriptions, computer equipment, and reliable internet. The Royal Cup does not provide software subscriptions.

- COMPENSATION: You accept $5 USD per hour, up to seven authorized hours weekly, with a maximum initial budget of $35 per week.

- RELIABILITY: You can work independently, follow established brand guidelines, communicate professionally, and meet agreed deadlines.



IMPORTANT: Free software versions, promises to upgrade after hiring, or intentions to learn advanced techniques do not satisfy these requirements.



Additional software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve Studio is welcome but does not replace CapCut Pro and Canva Pro.



If you meet every qualification above, continue reading. Your understanding of this posting will be part of our screening process.



----------------------------------------



CREATIVE REFERENCES — REQUIRED VIEWING



The Royal Cup is a luxury private bartending experience. Our content must sell the EXPERIENCE, not simply advertise a product.



Review ALL FOUR references before applying.



01 — BRAND IDENTITY | BRIDGERTON







Our brand atmosphere: royalty, elegance, sophistication, exclusivity, and cinematic anticipation.



This reference establishes how The Royal Cup should look and feel.



02 — TECHNICAL EDITING | ELEVATE RISE







Our technical editing benchmark: dynamic pacing, sophisticated transitions, cinematic movement, visual effects, and precise synchronization.



Applicants must already demonstrate comparable editing capabilities.



03 — LUXURY COCKTAIL PRESENTATION | UNCLE NEAREST







Our beverage presentation standard: pristine glassware, controlled lighting, elegant close-ups, smooth liquid movement, and immaculate visual quality.



Our goal is to elevate cocktail craftsmanship into a luxurious visual experience.



04 — EMOTIONAL IMPACT | GREAT MAN CELEBRATION







Our emotional storytelling benchmark: grandeur, elegance, excitement, celebration, and exclusivity.



The viewer should finish watching and wish they were part of the experience.



OUR CREATIVE STANDARD



- Bridgerton: WHO WE ARE.

- Elevate Rise: HOW PROFESSIONALLY WE EDIT.

- Uncle Nearest: HOW BEAUTIFULLY WE PRESENT COCKTAILS.

- Great Man Celebration: HOW WE WANT THE AUDIENCE TO FEEL.



These are creative references, not instructions to copy copyrighted footage or branding.



If your existing work does not demonstrate comparable cinematic abilities, please do not apply.



----------------------------------------



ABOUT THE ROYAL CUP



The Royal Cup is a luxury private bartending experience specializing in exceptional presentation, refined hospitality, and memorable celebrations.



Our philosophy:



"Where every drink is the perfect drink."



We create experiences that embody luxury, elegance, glamour, and sophistication.



Our established visual identity incorporates royal gold, black, royal purple, polished metals, crystal glassware, dramatic lighting, refined typography, and cinematic storytelling.



Our marketing should resemble a luxury lifestyle film or exclusive gala experience, not a generic retail advertisement.



----------------------------------------



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Transform supplied cocktail and event footage into polished, cinematic Instagram Reels, typically 15–30 seconds.

- Create compelling opening hooks and visually engaging storytelling sequences.

- Apply speed ramping, masking, keyframe animation, motion graphics, sophisticated transitions, and professional sound design.

- Perform color correction and grading for consistent luxury presentation.

- Synchronize visual movement, music, and sound effects.

- Design elegant Instagram graphics and carousels using Canva Pro.

- Follow The Royal Cup's approved logos, typography, colors, and brand guidelines without unauthorized modifications.

- Organize editable project files and maintain professional file management.

- Implement feedback efficiently and professionally.

- Communicate production timelines, concerns, and progress.

- Complete approved deliverables within agreed deadlines and authorized hours.



Exceptional quality takes priority over excessive content volume.



----------------------------------------



COMPENSATION & WORK STRUCTURE



Hourly Rate: $5 USD

Weekly Budget: Up to $35 USD

Authorized Hours: Up to 7 hours weekly

Schedule: Consistent, mutually agreed production blocks

Initial Evaluation: Three weeks, fully paid



The Royal Cup uses a DELIVERABLES-DRIVEN WORKFLOW WITH HOURLY COMPENSATION.



Rather than requiring complex cinematic work to be completed in fragmented one-hour shifts, we allow scheduled production blocks that support uninterrupted creative work.



HOW IT WORKS:



1. Each week, the editor receives a creative brief with approved deliverables, priorities, and deadlines.



2. Work hours are scheduled and authorized in advance.



3. The editor completes assignments while accurately tracking actual working hours.



4. Deliverables are reviewed for cinematic quality, brand consistency, and technical execution.



5. Feedback and revisions are managed within the agreed scope and available paid time.



6. If additional hours are necessary, the editor must notify management before exceeding the authorized allocation so the scope, timeline, or budget can be adjusted.



Additional hours require prior approval. All hours worked must be accurately reported and compensated in accordance with applicable requirements.



The $35 weekly amount is a maximum initial budget, not a guaranteed flat weekly payment. Compensation is based on actual hours worked.



THREE-WEEK PAID EVALUATION



WEEK 1 — CREATIVE ALIGNMENT

Demonstrate your ability to interpret our luxury brand identity and produce polished cinematic content from supplied footage.



WEEK 2 — TECHNICAL EXECUTION

Demonstrate advanced editing capabilities, attention to detail, professional revisions, and consistent brand presentation.



WEEK 3 — INDEPENDENT PRODUCTION

Demonstrate reliability, communication, time management, and the ability to complete assigned work with limited supervision.



Performance will be evaluated based on:



- Cinematic storytelling and visual quality

- Luxury brand alignment

- Technical editing proficiency

- Attention to detail

- Responsiveness to feedback

- Communication and reliability

- Production efficiency and time management



Continued engagement after the evaluation depends on performance, business needs, and mutual agreement.



There is NO separate paid pre-employment editing assessment for this recruitment round.



----------------------------------------



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We are seeking a creative professional who understands the difference between assembling promotional clips and producing an immersive cinematic experience.



The ideal candidate possesses:



- An exceptional eye for luxury presentation

- Advanced, demonstrated video editing skills

- Strong creative judgment and storytelling ability

- Independence and problem-solving skills

- Attention to detail and brand consistency

- Professional communication and reliability

- Accountability and responsiveness to feedback

- A genuine interest in a long-term creative partnership



Experience creating content for luxury hospitality, upscale events, premium lifestyle brands, fashion, fine dining, or high-end promotional films is highly desirable.



----------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY — REQUIRED QUESTIONS



Answer EVERY question below in numerical order.



Incomplete applications or applications that fail mandatory requirements may be excluded.



1. SOFTWARE VERIFICATION — YES OR NO



Do you CURRENTLY have your own active, paid subscriptions?



CapCut Pro: YES / NO



Canva Pro: YES / NO



Both must be YES to qualify.



Do not answer YES if you use free versions, rely on unauthorized shared access, or intend to upgrade after hiring.



List any additional professional editing software you currently use.



2. LUXURY CINEMATIC PORTFOLIO



After watching all four creative references, provide direct links to THREE existing videos you personally edited that demonstrate comparable cinematic quality.



Prioritize luxury, hospitality, premium lifestyle, fashion, or upscale event content.



Submit three SPECIFIC video links, not an entire portfolio containing unrelated projects.



All links must be accessible without requesting special permissions.



3. EDITING AUTHORSHIP



For each submitted video, briefly explain your personal contributions.



Identify any advanced transitions, speed ramping, masking, motion graphics, keyframe animations, color grading, sound design, or typography you personally completed.



Clearly distinguish your work from collaborative contributions.



4. TECHNICAL REFERENCE ANALYSIS



After watching the Elevate Rise reference, identify THREE specific editing techniques demonstrated in the video.



Explain how you would apply those techniques to footage from a luxury private bartending experience.



5. PRODUCTION TIME



How many working hours would you realistically need to produce one polished 20–30-second cinematic Reel using supplied footage?



State separately:



- Estimated initial editing time

- Estimated time for one round of revisions



Accuracy is more important than unrealistic speed claims.



6. COMPENSATION CONFIRMATION — YES OR NO



Do you accept ALL the following terms?



- $5 USD hourly rate

- Up to 7 authorized hours weekly

- Maximum initial weekly budget of $35

- Consistent, preapproved production blocks

- Deliverables-driven workflow with hourly compensation

- Three-week paid evaluation if selected

- No unauthorized overtime



I ACCEPT ALL TERMS: YES / NO



If your expectations exceed the advertised compensation arrangement, please do not apply.



7. SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY



Provide:



- Your time zone

- Preferred consistent working hours

- Earliest available start date

- Confirmation you can meet agreed deadlines and maintain approved schedules



----------------------------------------



SELECTION PROCESS



STAGE 1 — QUALIFICATION SCREENING

Verify active CapCut Pro and Canva Pro subscriptions, compensation acceptance, and scheduling compatibility.



STAGE 2 — PORTFOLIO REVIEW

Evaluate three personally edited videos for luxury visual quality, cinematic execution, and brand relevance.



STAGE 3 — TECHNICAL REVIEW

Assess creative knowledge, production estimates, and understanding of our video references.



STAGE 4 — FIRST-ROUND INTERVIEW

Qualified candidates discuss their editing experience, workflow, reliability, and creative approach.



STAGE 5 — THREE-WEEK PAID EVALUATION

The selected candidate completes real assignments under a structured, compensated evaluation.



Only candidates who satisfy the mandatory requirements and demonstrate relevant creative ability will advance.



----------------------------------------



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are not simply searching for someone who can trim footage, add captions, or assemble ordinary promotional advertisements.



We are seeking a creative partner who can transform authentic moments into sophisticated, cinematic experiences that inspire audiences to celebrate, connect, and create lasting memories.



If you already possess the required professional tools, advanced editing capabilities, luxury creative sensibility, and professional discipline, we welcome your application.



The Royal Cup

Where every drink is the perfect drink.

**About the Company**



We are a national business brokerage firm based in the United States. We help business owners sell their businesses and train licensed real estate agents to become professional business brokers. We are a growing, professional company building our brand presence on LinkedIn,
, and YouTube, and strengthening our organic search presence through smart SEO.

**About the Role**



This is not a standard social media job. We are looking for a skilled, self-directed Digital Marketing Coordinator who can handle both social media management and search engine optimization — using professional tools and working within a structured approval system.



You will be given a Claude AI team seat for content creation, access to Buffer for scheduling, and access to SEMrush for SEO and content intelligence. You will be expected to use all three tools together to build our audience, grow our online presence, and drive real results over time.



If you only know how to post content and have no SEO experience, this role is not for you. If you can do both — and do both well — we want to hear from you.



---



**Important — Account Security**



Our 
 and
 accounts are brand new. We are starting from zero and need to grow our audience aggressively but intelligently. We have had previous social media accounts shut down due to overseas team members logging in directly from foreign IP addresses. That will not happen again.



You will never log in directly to our 
 or
 accounts. All content and scheduling activity on those platforms must go through Buffer only. Connection requests on LinkedIn will be handled separately by a US-based team member. Your job is content, scheduling, SEO, and engagement — all managed through the approved tools.



If you do not understand why this matters or cannot commit to it, please do not apply.

, and YouTube using Claude AI, keeping everything tightly aligned with our company message and voice

, and LinkedIn — proper dimensions, thumbnails, captions, descriptions, and hashtags

**SEO — Weekly and Monthly**

- Use SEMrush to research keywords our target audience is actively searching for and build our content calendar around those terms

- Monitor the search rankings of our website pages and report on progress weekly

- Identify on-page SEO opportunities — weak page titles, missing meta descriptions, thin content — and flag them to our web team for implementation

- Research competitors to identify content gaps and opportunities we can own

- Conduct backlink audits using SEMrush and identify quality directories, publications, and websites for outreach

- Perform monthly link building outreach — directory submissions and targeted guest post or mention pitches

- Optimize every YouTube video title, description, and tags for YouTube search

- Monitor our domain authority and backlink profile growth over time

- Deliver a monthly SEO report covering rankings, traffic trends, backlink growth, and what moved the needle



---

- Experience optimizing content and YouTube videos for search

- Experience with link building outreach — directory submissions and publisher or blog pitches

- Experience using Claude or ChatGPT for content creation

- Experience formatting video content for LinkedIn,
, and YouTube

- Ability to work within a strict approval workflow — nothing goes live without sign-off

- Deep knowledge of LinkedIn account safety — what triggers restrictions, how to warm up a new account, and how to grow without getting flagged

- Experience managing community engagement — responding to comments and messages on behalf of a brand

- Self-motivated, organized, and consistent — this role requires daily attention and monthly reporting



**Nice to Have**

- Background in financial services, real estate, or business consulting

- Experience with Canva or similar tools for graphics

- Experience growing a LinkedIn Company Page from scratch

- Familiarity with Google Search Console alongside SEMrush



---



**What We Provide**

- A Claude AI team seat for all content creation

- Access to Buffer for scheduling and publishing

- Access to SEMrush for SEO and content intelligence

- All video assets and brand materials — you are not starting from nothing

- Clear approval workflows — no guessing what to post or what direction to go

- Stable, ongoing part-time work with a growing US-based firm
