title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
The role



Keep the money moving. Know when something breaks before a customer does, find out why, and fix it so it can’t happen the same way again.



- Own production health. Alerts, uptime checks and on-call: if a system stops or a payout stops moving, you hear first.

- Run the i
. Take charge when something breaks, keep people updated in plain words, and write a short postmortem that leads to a real fix.

- Fix the code, not just the servers. Most of our failures sit between us and our providers: webhooks, timeouts, retries, duplicate events. Trace them through the code and raise the PR.

- Make deployments and rollbacks boring. One command, repeatable, safe to run on a busy day.

- Plan for capacity. Database size, memory, rate limits, log retention. Act before the limit is hit.

- Write runbooks so anyone on the team can clear a stuck payout.



What we need



- You communicate well. This matters most. During an i
 you say what you know, what you don’t, and what happens next. Clear updates for non-technical people. You ask early instead of guessing, and you respond fast when money is stuck.

- You’ve run production systems. 3+ years running services in production, including on-call. Comfortable on Linux servers over SSH, with process managers, logs and cloud infrastructure (we use AWS). You can find the cause of an outage from logs and metrics alone.

- You can build backend software. You read and write Node.js/TypeScript well enough to fix a bug in a payment flow, with tests. You understand APIs, webhooks, signatures, and safe retries (idempotency).

- You think in failure modes. What happens if the provider is slow, the callback arrives twice, or out of order, or never? What if the database fills up, or the box reboots mid-payout? You design for that instead of finding out in production.



Nice to have



MongoDB at scale (Atlas, indexes, slow queries, capacity). Payments or fintech experience. Monitoring and log tools (Grafana, Datadog, Loki or similar). Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible). CI/CD pipelines.
 bot or messaging 
. Basic security instincts: secrets handling, access control, one tenant seeing another’s data.

title: Senior Network Engineer - Carrier / Service Provider Backbone (Juniper, Remote)
description:
Senior Network Engineer - Carrier / Service Provider Backbone (Juniper)

FDC Servers (AS30058) | Fully remote | Senior (L3) | Independent contractor



ABOUT FDC SERVERS

FDC Servers (AS30058) is a global dedicated server, colocation, and IP transit provider operating our own international backbone across 27+ points of presence in North America, Europe, APAC, and LATAM, with over 100 Tbps of installed external network capacity. We run a true service-provider network: carrier peering, IP transit, DDoS mitigation, and high-throughput hosting infrastructure. We are expanding our network engineering team.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer with a genuine carrier / service provider background. You have spent years hands-on inside a Tier 1 or Tier 2 carrier, IP transit provider, or large ISP backbone, working on Juniper at scale.



This is not an enterprise networking role. If your experience is primarily corporate campus, office LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, or enterprise data center, this position is not a fit. We need engineers who have lived in a live SP production environment: full BGP tables, carrier peering, IX fabrics, MPLS/SR backbones, and maintenance windows where a mistake has real blast radius.



You will act as the L3 authority on our global backbone, owning complex routing escalations, architecture decisions, capacity planning, and mentoring our Tier 2 team, working alongside our existing US/EU engineers. This role is fully remote.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Act as the ultimate L3 escalation point for complex routing, switching, and backbone infrastructure i
 across a global carrier-grade network.

- Configure, maintain, and optimize core/aggregation/edge Juniper (QFX, PTX) routers and switches, with occasional support for Cisco platforms (IOS-XR, NX-OS).

- Architect, manage, and troubleshoot ISIS, BGP, IP/MPLS, SR-MPLS, SRv6, routing policy, and scalability at carrier scale.

- Manage transit, peering, and IX relationships at the technical level: BGP policy, communities, traffic engineering, and inbound/outbound path optimization across multiple Tier 1 carriers.

- Lead mitigation during severe network anomalies and DDoS events using BGP Flowspec, RTBH, and traffic scrubbing workflows.

- Drive capacity planning, redundancy reviews, circuit turn-ups, backbone migrations, and major Junos software upgrades.

- Validate and peer-review complex network change scripts (Juniper set-style) prior to implementation in maintenance windows.

- Mentor Tier 2 network engineers, establishing troubleshooting procedures and clear escalation boundaries.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- Prior employment with a Tier 1 / Tier 2 carrier, IP transit provider, ISP, or large-scale hosting/data center network operator. Enterprise-only backgrounds will not be considered.

- Expert-level hands-on Juniper Junos experience in a live SP production environment (QFX/PTX class hardware).

- Deep operational command of Service Provider protocols: ISIS, BGP (full tables, peering, transit policy), IP/MPLS, SR-MPLS, SRv6, EVPN.

- Practical experience with BGP Flowspec, L3VPN/L2VPN, anycast gateways, and traffic engineering on a production backbone.

- Experience evaluating SP-grade hardware limitations: line-card vs. ASIC/SoC architectures, FIB scale, and platform selection.

- Advanced Layer 2/3 troubleshooting: packet capture analysis, deep route table analysis, log parsing under pressure.

- Strong risk-assessment mindset: you understand blast radius and customer impact before touching a production router.

- Professional written and spoken English for documentation, post-mortems, and mentoring.



PREFERRED

- JNCIP-SP or JNCIE-SP certification (or demonstrably equivalent experience).

- Network automation: Ansible, NetBox API, Python, Git.

- Cisco IOS-XR / NX-OS experience in SP or spine-and-leaf environments.

- Experience directing remote hands teams for complex deployments, fiber rollouts, and infrastructure audits.



IDEAL CANDIDATE

You came up through carrier NOCs and backbone engineering teams, not corporate IT. You take absolute ownership of network health, thrive in high-stakes maintenance windows, and can move between hands-on Junos work and architectural oversight without dropping either. You will be a reliable anchor for our Tier 2 team and a senior technical presence on our global backbone.



ENGAGEMENT

- Fully remote, long-term independent contractor engagement.

- Pay by agreement, based on experience.



ID-verified accounts only.



Note to recruiting and staffing agencies: please do not contact us regarding this posting. We work with direct candidates only.

title: On-Call Personal & Property Assistant – UK Property Business (ad hoc, 2–15 hrs/week, works alongside another job)
description:
On-Call Personal & Property Assistant for a UK property business: ad hoc, usually 2–15 hours a week



About us

We're a small, family-run UK property business that lets houses, rooms and studios. The owner wants a dependable assistant for the property side and for some personal admin, which is why this is a combined personal and property assistant role. He has other businesses too, but they won't be your focus. He has worked with remote assistants for several years.



How we work: led by AI, powered by a person

AI agents already run much of our day-to-day work. They triage the inboxes, draft and send
s and WhatsApp messages (sometimes on your behalf, sometimes on their own account), track tasks and follow set routines for lettings and property management. You'll work mainly with two of these agents. They'll brief you, tell you what needs doing and support you as you go.



What they can't replace is a sensible, reliable person. You will be:



• The eyes and brain. Bring common sense to what the AI is doing. Spot anything that looks wrong or unusual, help it get past blockers, and check that it's following its routines and doing its repeat work reliably.

• The hands. Make and take phone calls, make judgement calls, and do the things a person can do more easily, quickly or better, including the times when a personal, human touch matters.



AI will assist and lead the work, but the right person will always be an important part of how we operate. You don't need to be a UK property expert. You do need to be dependable and switched on, and comfortable working with AI tools.



What we're looking for, honestly. We hire a person for what AI can't do well: real judgement, overseeing the AI and spotting its gaps and mistakes, and being a real human voice on the phone. People like knowing there's a person behind our messages. We'll be judging this. If someone would only be doing what an AI could do, it won't be the right fit. We want someone who enjoys working alongside AI and filling its gaps, not someone frustrated by it.



When we need you

This is ad hoc work, not a fixed shift. Most weeks it's somewhere between 2 and 15 hours, depending on what's going on with the properties (lettings, viewings, repairs) and with the owner's personal admin and travel. Many of our best candidates have another job or clients, and that's fine.



What matters is that you stay reachable through the UK day, from your phone and your computer (we're busiest roughly 9am–5:30pm UK time, which is 5pm–1:30am Philippine time in UK winter), and that you triage well. An
 often doesn't need an answer for hours. A tenant WhatsApp may need a reply in minutes. A viewer phoning because they can't find the property needs you now. Judging what needs what response, while you get on with your day, is the core skill.



Phone calls. This isn't a call-heavy job. We encourage everyone to use WhatsApp and
, and the more responsive you are there, the fewer calls you'll get. But some calls can't wait, and these are the times you must keep your phone close:



• Viewing blocks, for example 90 minutes of back-to-back viewings, when people may have access problems, need the full address, or call to make an offer.

• Access windows, when a contractor or cleaner is going into a property and a tenant needs to let them in.



You'll usually know about these windows in advance. We're also planning to add an AI that answers calls first, deals with the simple ones, takes messages for non-urgent ones, and only puts through the calls that need a person.



The most important thing is good triage and reliable responsiveness: seeing things quickly on WhatsApp and
, judging what needs action now and what can wait, and being by the phone during the windows we agree in advance.



Weekend work is occasional, mainly messages with the owner, a viewing day, a tenant issue, or helping with his personal plans. You'll usually know in advance when you need to be especially available. Work comes in short bursts of ad hoc tasks, not long fixed shifts.



What we provide



• A work phone number on a VoIP app that rings on both your phone and your computer. We pay for the line. You'll use it to call UK numbers and to take incoming calls.

• WhatsApp, which we use heavily for messaging.

• Google Workspace, and AI agents to brief you and draft for you.



What you'll do



• Phone calls to UK numbers: contractors such as plumbers, electricians and other trades, letting agents, suppliers, utility companies, councils (when approved) and tenants. You'll get a short brief before each call and report back afterwards on what was agreed.

• Incoming calls on the work number when needed, such as during viewings or access windows.

• Messaging tenants, applicants and contractors by WhatsApp and
, following our scripts and rules.

• Arranging contractors and viewings: booking slots, confirming access and attendance, and chasing.

• Following up: making sure what was promised actually happens (repairs, quotes, documents, payments), and flagging it when it doesn't.

• Overseeing the AI: checking its drafts, lists and records, making sure it keeps to its routines, and speaking up when something looks off.

• Light admin: filing and simple updates in Google Sheets and Docs.

• Personal assistant tasks for the owner: booking appointments, calling companies on his behalf, chasing deliveries and refunds, and other everyday admin.



Requirements



• Good spoken English. You'll need to be clear and confident on UK phone calls and able to follow UK accents.

• Good written English for messages and notes (the AI agents help with drafting).

• Connected through the day on both mobile and desktop (WhatsApp and our VoIP work number on both), quick to judge what needs a fast reply, and able to take calls during agreed viewing and access windows.

• Reliable internet with a backup for power or internet cuts (e.g. mobile data, UPS or inverter), a quiet place to take calls, a headset, and a smartphone and computer that can run a VoIP app.

• Comfortable with Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets) and happy to work alongside AI tools.

• Common sense, and the confidence to flag things that don't look right.

• Discreet and trustworthy, because you'll handle people's personal information.

• Organised, with clear notes recording who said what, when, and any dates and amounts.



Nice to have (not required)



• Experience in UK property or lettings, real estate VA work, or customer service.

• Experience making calls to UK or US businesses.

• Experience with OpenRent, SpareRoom, Rightmove or similar.

• Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grok or similar at work.



How to apply

We read every application that follows these steps. Applications that skip any step won't be considered.



• Subject line: start it with KETTLE ON – [your first name] so we know you've read this post.

• Availability: tell us when you're usually reachable, in UK time, Monday to Sunday. If you have another job or clients (that's fine), tell us their hours and how you'd keep an eye on WhatsApp and
 around them. Could you keep your phone free for a pre-arranged 60–90 minute window, such as a viewing block, on most weekdays?

• Voice recording (required, 1–2 minutes): send a link (Google Drive, Vocaroo or similar) to a natural recording that isn't read from a script. In it: (a) introduce yourself and say when you're available in UK time; and (b) act out this call in your own words. You're phoning a plumber for a landlord client about a leaking kitchen tap at one of his rental flats. Find out their earliest availability this week and their call-out charge, and explain that the tenant can give access after 2pm.

• Short written answers, in your own words:

   – (a) Tell us about a time you had to chase someone who kept missing a deadline. What did you do?

   – (b) Tell us about a time you spotted a mistake someone else (or a tool) had made. What did you do about it?

   – (c) What's your typical response time on WhatsApp during your available hours, and how would you handle an incoming work call while you're busy with something else?

   – (d) What internet speed do you have, and what's your backup if the power or internet goes down?

   – (e) What is your expected rate (US$ or £ per hour)?

• Your CV.



Pay and start: you'll be paid by the hour, at your agreed rate, for the work you do. There's no retainer and no minimum hours. You'll keep a simple log of your tasks and time and bill from it. We'd prefer an immediate start, but we can be flexible.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a short paid test task and a 20-minute call that includes a quick phone role-play.



Individuals only. No agencies or automation services, please.

title: Freelance Magazine Designer Wanted – Online Whisky Magazine (Potential Long-Term Collaboration)
description:
Hey!



We are looking for a creative and experienced freelance magazine designer to develop a professional, modern, and visually appealing template for an upcoming online whisky magazine.



This is initially a one-time project, but we are specifically looking for someone who is interested in a potential long-term collaboration.



Our goal is to create a premium digital publication with a strong visual identity, beautiful layouts, and an enjoyable reading experience.



The Project



We need a professional, reusable magazine template that can accommodate different types of editorial content, photography, reviews, and feature articles.



The design should feel premium, modern, elegant, and visually distinctive, reflecting the atmosphere of the whisky industry.



Think of a high-quality lifestyle or luxury magazine rather than a basic newsletter or a collection of standard templates.



We want something that looks professionally designed and stands out.



Further details about the magazine, its structure, and our specific requirements will be shared with selected candidates.



Design Software



You are free to use your preferred design software, including Canva, Adobe InDesign, Affinity Publisher, Figma, or similar tools.



Canva is absolutely fine, provided the result looks professional and the template is fully editable.



The final deliverable must be reusable, allowing us to update content and create future editions without rebuilding the design from scratch.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Has proven experience in magazine design, editorial layouts, or digital publications



Has a strong portfolio with examples of previously published or completed work



Understands typography, visual hierarchy, spacing, and professional page composition



Can create a consistent and recognizable visual identity



Knows how to combine photography and editorial content effectively



Can deliver a professional, fully editable template



Works independently and communicates clearly



Meets deadlines and is open to feedback



Is interested in a potential long-term collaboration



Experience with lifestyle, luxury, food and drink, or similar publications is a strong advantage.



You don't need to be a whisky expert, but an understanding of premium branding and editorial design is important.



Budget



$100–$150 USD for the complete magazine template.



This is a fixed-price, one-time project.



The exact fee will depend on your experience, portfolio, and proposed approach.



We expect a professional and reusable template, not simply a collection of generic layouts.



The exact scope and deliverables will be discussed with the selected designer before starting the project.



Potential Long-Term Collaboration



Although this project starts with creating a magazine template, we are particularly interested in finding someone who would like to work with us on a recurring basis.



If we are satisfied with your work, we may hire you monthly to design and prepare each new magazine edition.



The process would be straightforward:



We provide: The articles, images, and editorial content.



You provide: The magazine layout, visual presentation, and final publication-ready design.



Monthly compensation would be discussed separately, depending on the workload and requirements.



Ideally, we want to find someone who can become our regular magazine designer and help us build a consistent visual identity over time.



Important – Experience and Portfolio Required



We are specifically looking for someone with genuine experience in editorial or magazine design.



Unfortunately, we have experienced situations where freelancers claimed to have professional design experience, but the quality of their work did not match their promises.



For this reason, we place great importance on portfolios and examples of actual work.



Please do not apply simply because you know how to use Canva or another design tool.



We want someone who understands professional editorial design and can demonstrate that through previous projects.



Examples of previously published magazine designs, editorial spreads, or similar professional work are strongly preferred.



Want to Stand Out? Show Us Your Vision!



We would love to see how you envision a premium online whisky magazine.



Applicants who include a sample design of 1–2 magazine pages will have an advantage during our selection process.



This could be a magazine cover, an editorial page, or a 2-page spread showing your creative interpretation of a whisky publication.



This is entirely optional, and we do not expect applicants to complete a full design project for free.



We simply want to get a better understanding of your creativity, design style, and ability to create a premium editorial experience.



A strong portfolio combined with an interesting visual concept will certainly catch our attention.



How to Apply



If you are interested, please send us:



Your portfolio, preferably including previously published magazines or editorial design projects.



A short introduction about yourself and your relevant design experience.



Which design software you prefer to use.



Your proposed fee within our $100–$150 budget.



Your estimated delivery time.



Whether you are interested in potential monthly design assignments.



Optional (applicants who include this will have an advantage): A 1–2 page sample showing how you envision our digital whisky magazine.



Please also explain why you believe you are the right designer for this project.



We are interested in your experience, creative approach, and ability to deliver professional work, not just general statements about your design skills.



What You Can Expect



Clear communication and constructive feedback



Creative freedom within the project's direction



The opportunity to contribute to a growing digital publication



Potential recurring monthly assignments



A professional and reliable long-term collaboration



We are looking for someone who combines creativity with professionalism and understands how to turn editorial content into a visually engaging digital magazine.



If you have experience designing magazines, a strong portfolio, and an eye for premium editorial design, we would love to hear from you!



We look forward to seeing your work and creative ideas.

title: Full-Time B2B Cold Caller (Canada): Guaranteed Base + Bonus for Every Meeting Held
description:
Good on the phone? This job pays you for it.



We're Canadian Funding Partners, a private Canadian company that helps businesses get government funding. You'll phone owners of small and mid-size Canadian businesses and book short calls with our specialists. You don't sell and you don't close. You open the door, and our team does the rest.



WHY GOOD CALLERS LIKE THIS JOB

- A real offer. Many owners don't know there's funding for their business, so you're calling with something useful.

- You book; you don't close. Your goal is a 15-minute call on the calendar.

- Fresh leads and a fast power dialer, ready on day one.

- Pay that rewards results: a guaranteed monthly base, plus a bonus for every meeting that's held. No cap on bonuses.

- Your numbers speak for you. Every call is measured automatically, so good work gets seen. Hit the numbers and we leave you alone.

- Your trial day is paid.



PAY

- A guaranteed monthly base, paid twice a month.

- Plus a bonus for every meeting you book that is held. No cap.

- A meeting counts as held when the owner shows up, is qualified (incorporated, 5 or more staff), and is interested in using AI in their business. We confirm this after each meeting.

- We share the exact figures with shortlisted applicants.



HOURS: Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern (10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. Philippine time).



WHAT A NORMAL DAY LOOKS LIKE

- 120+ dials on a power dialer

- 4+ hours actually on the phone

- Every missed callback returned within 15 minutes

- One lunch break. No disappearing.



THIS JOB IS FOR YOU IF

- you've done at least 1 year of outbound cold calling or appointment setting, ideally B2B to North America

- your spoken English is clear and confident

- you have a quiet room, a noise-cancelling headset, a computer, internet of 25 Mbps or more, and a backup connection

- you can work the hours above, every weekday

- French is a plus, not required



IT'S NOT FOR YOU IF

- you can't make 120 calls a day, every day

- rejection gets to you

- you need weeks of training before you're good

- you want a quiet, low-pressure job (this is the opposite)

- your internet or your room isn't reliable



HOW WE HIRE (FAST)

1. You send the application below.

2. We listen to every recording. Shortlisted applicants get a short prep guide and a 15-minute AI calling test (about 12 practice calls that get harder). The best then do a live mock call with us.

3. Those who pass do one paid trial day on real calls.

4. Then we review day by day. Hit the numbers and you stay.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY, THIS IS PART OF THE TEST)



 
 with this exact subject line:

Caller – [Your full name] – [Dials per day at your last job]



The first line of your
 must be the word MAPLE.



Attach or link all five of these:

1. Your CV (PDF)

2. Recording 1: you reading the script below, as if it were a real call (MP3 or M4A, under 5 MB)

3. Recording 2: your answer, in your own words, to "I'm busy, just send me an
." (60 seconds max)

4. A 60–90 second video introducing yourself. Send a link (unlisted YouTube, Google Drive or Loom), set to "anyone with the link".

5. A screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net) and a photo of where you'll work



Applications that are missing anything, or that don't follow these instructions, are deleted without reply.



Your recordings and documents are used only to assess your application. We use AI tools to help review them, and they are deleted within 90 days.



SCRIPT FOR RECORDING 1



"Hi, is this the owner? Great, thank you. My name is ___, and I'm calling from Northpoint Advisory in Toronto. We help small businesses in Canada find out whether they qualify for government programs that cover part of the cost of training their staff. I'm not selling anything today. I just need two quick questions to see whether a 15-minute call with one of our specialists makes sense. How many employees do you have? And is the business incorporated? Perfect. I have Tuesday at 10:30 a.m. or Thursday at 2:15 p.m. Eastern. Which works better? And what's the best
 for the invite?"

title: Meta and Google Ads Manager
description:
Meta & Google Ads Manager

DTC Fashion & Jewelry | Remote | Freelance / Part-Time



About Us



We're launching two direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands:



Above: Curated men's fashion with an elevated, minimalist aesthetic.

KAEN: Modern women's jewelry focused on design and accessible luxury.



We're looking for a performance-driven Meta & Google Ads Manager to build, launch, and scale profitable paid advertising campaigns for both brands.



Your Mission



Own paid customer acquisition from campaign setup → testing → optimization → scaling



Your goal is to acquire customers profitably, identify winning products and creatives, and build a repeatable advertising system.



You'll work directly with the founder and a separate Creative Strategist & Producer.



Responsibilities



Account Setup: Configure and manage Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, Pixel, Conversions API, Google Merchant Center, and conversion tracking.

Campaign Strategy: Develop launch strategies, budget allocations, campaign structures, and testing plans for both brands.

Execution: Build and manage Meta and Google campaigns, including Shopping/PMax, Search, and retargeting where appropriate.

Optimization: Monitor CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, AOV, and profitability. Optimize budgets, audiences, campaigns, and product feeds.

Creative Collaboration: Identify winning and losing creatives, provide actionable briefs to the creative producer, and recommend new testing angles.

Scaling: Increase spend systematically when campaigns demonstrate profitable, repeatable performance.

Reporting: Provide concise weekly reports covering spend, revenue, CAC, ROAS, key learnings, and next actions.



First 30 Days



- Audit and configure advertising accounts and tracking for both brands.

- Verify purchase attribution and conversion events.

- Develop a launch media plan with clear budgets and target acquisition costs.

- Launch controlled advertising tests using approved creatives.

- Identify early product and creative performance signals.

- Establish a weekly reporting and optimization process.



Requirements



- Proven experience managing Meta and Google Ads for DTC e-commerce brands.

- Strong knowledge of Shopify, GA4, Google Merchant Center, and conversion tracking.

- Experience with physical products, preferably fashion, jewelry, beauty, or lifestyle.

- Ability to independently manage campaigns and recommend strategic improvements.

- Understanding of contribution margins, CAC, ROAS, and profitable scaling.

- Strong analytical skills and clear communication.

- Comfortable working with a separate creative production team.



 Compensation



Freelance / part-time initially, with potential for long-term collaboration. Hourly, fixed monthly, or performance-based arrangements considered.





To Apply



Please answer:



1. Show two or three DTC e-commerce accounts you've personally managed, including monthly ad spend, revenue, CAC, and ROAS. Explain your direct responsibilities.

2. Have you launched a new Shopify brand from zero sales? Walk us through your first 30 days.

3. How would you allocate an initial $100–$200/day advertising budget between Meta and Google for a brand with no conversion history?

4. How do you verify that Meta, Google, and Shopify purchase tracking is accurate?

5. How do you determine when to scale, pause, or change a campaign?

6. What's your hourly/monthly rate, availability, and minimum commitment?



**We're looking for someone who can independently build and manage a profitable acquisition system—not just launch campaigns and report ROAS. We value verified results, independent thinking, disciplined testing, and clear ownership.**

title: AI-Assisted Customer Support Specialist (Email & Social Media) | US Shopify Brand | Full Time
description:
➤ Who we are

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand selling to women in the US, Canada and the UK. Orders are growing fast. Our support team has two full-time agents today, and the volume now needs a third.

We are not the average e-commerce brand that stops caring once the order is paid. We want every customer happy, and a brand reputation that is spotless. That is why this role matters to us.



➤ This is not a typing job. It's a thinking job.

Customer support here is not about writing replies anymore. Our AI drafts the replies, and most of them are already very good.

Your job is to think: read every draft, check the order and the facts, fix what's wrong, and d
 what gets sent. You will work with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) all day. We need a sharp brain, not a fast typist.

And you own your queue. Every customer gets an answer. Every order problem gets followed until it is solved. Nothing gets forgotten. You don't need anyone to remind you.



➤ The team and your shift

You join two agents who already cover the US evening and the US night. You take the third shift, right after them: 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM Philippine time. With you, support runs around the clock, and the three of you hand over to each other.

A day shift is rare for a US brand. Here is why yours matters:

• Our UK customers are awake during your shift. You are their support team.

• Our supplier and fulfillment partners are in Asia, online at the same time as you. You are the one who gets answers from them the same day.

• You clear what is left in the inbox, so the US day starts with a clean queue. On the days one of your teammates is off, you carry a bigger part of that queue.

• Your shift is the calm one: fewer new tickets come in, so you have time to think. You are the person with the full picture: what is stuck, what was promised, what needs a follow-up.

• Before you log off, you brief the night agent: what happened, what is open, what to watch.



➤ What you will do

Customers always come first: support and comments are your priority every day. Supplier follow-ups fill the rest of your shift, and creator partnerships come later.



1. Customer support 
, AI-assisted)

• Review every AI-drafted reply in our inbox (Help Scout): check the order in Shopify and the tracking, correct or rewrite with AI when needed, then send.

• Handle order status, shipping delays, returns, refunds, exchanges and address changes.

• Handle sensitive cases calmly: upset customers, disputes and chargebacks.

• Spot when the AI gets something wrong, and report it so the system keeps getting better.



2. Social media moderation

• Check comments on our
 and Instagram pages and ads, every day.

• Reply, hide spam, and turn public complaints into solved tickets.



3. Supplier and fulfillment follow-up

• Follow up with our supplier and fulfillment partners on delayed, lost or wrong orders, while they are online.

• Make sure every stuck order gets a solution, and the customer hears about it.



4. Content creator partnerships (later, as the role grows)

• We are starting to work with content creators and influencers. It is close to customer support: you write to people, answer their questions, and follow up until it is done.

• Reach out to creators, coordinate product shipments, and track the content we receive.

• This is not for day one. It comes when support is under control and you have time in your shift.



➤ Schedule

• Full time, 6 days a week. Your day off is fixed: Wednesday, Thursday or Friday, agreed together.

• Shift: 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM Philippine time, 8 hours with 1 hour of breaks inside, so 7 hours of work a day. No night work, no split shift.

• The shift can move by one hour when the US changes its clocks.

• Being open to a 7th day during peak season is a big plus (paid extra).

• 100% remote, from the South East Asia time zone (Philippines preferred). Fast, reliable internet and a backup plan for power outages.

• Start: as soon as possible.



➤ Who you are

• Must have: 2+ years of customer support for an e-commerce brand on Shopify. This is required.

• Must have: you already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) regularly. If you don't use AI today, this role is not for you. We will train you on our system.

• A sharp, analytical mind: you read carefully, check the facts, and catch mistakes, including the AI's.

• Excellent written English: warm, clear and professional.

• Organized and detail-oriented. To prove it: in the application form, start your answer about the Shopify brands you supported with the word banana.

• Responsible. You follow up without being reminded, and you bring solutions, not only problems.

• Experience with a helpdesk (Help Scout, Gorgias, Zendesk or similar).

• Experience with
 and Instagram comment moderation.

• Bonus: experience talking to suppliers or fulfillment partners.

### 3. Social Media Publishing & Distribution

### 4. Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Support



- Insert approved calls to action directing viewers to 
.

- Support campaigns designed to generate qualified consultation bookings.

- Assist with landing-page copy, graphics, and marketing assets.

- Create content variations for testing different hooks, thumbnails, and messaging.

- Coordinate with the founder to ensure content aligns with business objectives.

- Support
 marketing and CRM campaigns when trained and authorized.



### 5. AI Tools & Workflow Automation



- Use AI-powered editing software to reduce repetitive work while maintaining professional quality.

- Work with tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Descript, CapCut, OpusClip, and Canva.

- Follow established workflows using Google Drive, project management systems, and approved automation tools.

- Help document repeatable processes for editing, approval, and publishing.

- Suggest improvements that increase productivity and reduce turnaround time.



### 6. Marketing Analytics & Reporting



- Monitor YouTube views, audience retention, click-through rates, and subscriber growth.

- Track short-form content engagement and referral traffic.

- Identify the video topics, thumbnails, and hooks producing the strongest results.

- Prepare a simple weekly performance report.

- Recommend practical improvements based on performance.

- Help measure how published content contributes to website visits and consultation bookings.



## Required Qualifications



- Demonstrated experience editing YouTube videos and short-form social media content.

- Proficiency with at least one professional editing platform.

- Strong understanding of YouTube, Instagram,
, and TikTok publishing requirements.

- Ability to create high-quality captions, graphics, and thumbnails.

- Strong attention to detail and visual consistency.

- Ability to communicate clearly in written English.

- Excellent organization and deadline management.

- Reliable internet access and a computer capable of editing video.

- Ability to work independently with limited supervision.

- Willingness to learn the OC360 Fitness brand, audience, and coaching philosophy.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience producing content for fitness, health, education, or coaching businesses.

- Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, or Adobe Audition.

- Familiarity with Descript, OpusClip, CapCut, or similar AI editing platforms.

- Experience with Canva and YouTube Studio.

- Basic understanding of YouTube SEO and audience retention.

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Activepieces, or marketing automation.

- Experience repurposing long-form content into multiple short-form clips.

- Experience using performance analytics to improve content results.



## Initial Performance Expectations



During the first 30 days, the successful candidate should:

2. Complete an approved sample YouTube video edit.

3. Create a repeatable editing and publishing checklist.

Once the workflow is established, the production goal is to support up to three YouTube videos per week with appropriate short-form repurposing. Actual output will depend on video length, editing complexity, available hours, and approved automation.

This position has the potential to develop into **Head of Growth — OC360 Fitness**, with expanded responsibility for:

title: Amazon Brand Protection Specialist: Unauthorized Sellers and Pending Trademark Brands
description:
MontBlack Inc. is an e-commerce distributor. We sell established consumer brands on Amazon, Walmart, and TikTok Shop. Our brands are known and have real demand. Some have a trademark application that is still pending and no full Brand Registry access yet. We need an experienced specialist who can remove resellers and unauthorized sellers from these listings, and who can help move each brand into Brand Registry faster.



What you will do



Audit each listing and map every seller: stock, price, Buy Box share, and when they first appeared.

Separate legitimate resellers from counterfeit, unauthorized, and hijacker offers.

Remove sellers on brands without a registered trademark, using the methods Amazon still accepts: authorization and distribution records, listing and condition violations, and policy complaints backed by evidence.

Advise on the fastest path to Brand Registry access while the application is pending.

Once access is granted, file and manage cases through Brand Registry, Report a Violation, and Amazon’s other brand protection tools.



Handle Amazon’s responses and appeals, including the case where Amazon says a seller is “authorized by the brand.”

Run test buys and record lot codes, expiration dates, and condition problems when a case needs proof.

Trace where resellers buy their stock so the brand can cut supply at the source.

Work with our legal counsel on cease and desist letters when a seller does not leave.

Send a weekly report: sellers removed, sellers remaining, cases open.



What you need



At least 2 to 3 years of hands-on Amazon brand enforcement.

Proven results on brands with a pending trademark and limited or no Brand Registry access. This is the experience we care about most.

Working knowledge of Brand Registry, Report a Violation, Project Zero, Transparency, and how Amazon reviews and rejects cases.

Strong written English and clear case documentation.

Comfortable using Keepa or a similar tool to track sellers and stock.



Nice to have



Experience with food and consumable brands.

Experience working with trademark counsel.



Who should not apply



General virtual assistants and generalist Amazon consultants.

Agencies sending a template proposal.

Anyone without direct removal results they can describe in detail.



What we are looking for

Someone who brings solutions to remove resellers from our brands’ Amazon listings. Tell us what you would do and how fast you can do it.



To apply

Apply through this job post. Start your application with this exact title as the first line:

Brand Protection: Pending Trademark: [Your Name]



Applications that do not start with this title will not be read.



Include the following:



Three removal cases on brands with a pending or no trademark. For each one: brand type, number of sellers, method, timeline, and result. Remove any brand names.

Your answer to this question: “A brand has a pending trademark application and Brand Registry access. 20 resellers hold 100 or more units each, and Amazon says the brand authorized them. What do you do in the first 30 days?”

Your answer to this question: “Name two tactics most people overlook when handling Brand Registry or enforcement, and when you use each one.”

Your years of experience, your rate, your time zone, and how many cases you can take per week.



We review every application that follows the format. Shortlisted candidates get a 20 minute call and a short trial task on a live listing. We reply within 2 business days.

title: FULL-TIME ONLINE FITNESS COACH & CLIENT PERFORMANCE SPECIALIST
description:
ABOUT OC360 FITNESS



OC360 Fitness is a United States-based online fitness coaching company that specializes in helping busy professional men ages 40–55 build muscle, reduce body fat, increase strength, and improve their overall physical fitness.



Our primary clients are busy engineering managers, directors, and professionals who want outstanding results without spending countless hours at the gym.



Our signature coaching program, the OC360 Aesthetic Athlete System™, is a premium 12-week online fitness coaching program priced at $2,997.



We combine structured strength training, practical nutrition strategies, personalized accountability, and progress monitoring to help clients build stronger, healthier bodies.



We are seeking a dedicated, knowledgeable, and professional Part-Time Online Fitness Coach & Client Performance Specialist based in the Philippines to help deliver an exceptional client coaching experience.



This is a long-term growth opportunity for a qualified fitness coach who wants to help build a growing international online fitness company.



POSITION OVERVIEW



The Online Fitness Coach will work directly with the founder to implement personalized exercise programs, monitor client progress, provide fitness and nutrition education, and help clients achieve their agreed fitness goals.



The ideal candidate has experience coaching clients remotely, understands strength training and fat-loss principles, communicates professionally in English, and is comfortable using fitness coaching software.



This is a genuine fitness coaching position, not simply an administrative virtual assistant role.



PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Personal Training & Exercise Programming



Create and customize resistance-training programs using OC360 Fitness coaching frameworks.



Design efficient strength-training routines appropriate for each client's abilities and goals.



Implement 3-day, 4-day, or other approved training schedules.



Provide exercise substitutions for home and gym environments.



Review client workout logs and training performance.



Recommend appropriate changes to training volume, intensity, and progression.



Provide exercise demonstrations and technique feedback using video when appropriate.



Help clients improve exercise consistency and adherence.



2. Client Progress Monitoring



Conduct weekly client progress reviews.



Track body weight, body measurements, workout completion, and strength improvements.



Review client-reported nutrition and activity records.



Identify clients who are struggling with consistency.



Document progress throughout the 12-week coaching program.



Prepare concise progress reports for the founder.



Escalate concerns that require the founder's attention.



3. Nutrition Education & Meal Planning Support



Help clients follow approved OC360 Fitness nutrition guidelines.



Provide general education about protein intake, calorie balance, and food choices.



Assist clients in using OC360 Fitness grocery lists and meal-planning resources.



Provide practical suggestions for meal preparation, dining out, and business travel.



Monitor nutrition adherence and identify barriers to consistency.



Refer medical nutrition concerns or requests for therapeutic diets to appropriately licensed professionals.



4. Client Accountability & Communication



Send personalized weekly check-in messages.



Provide encouragement, accountability, and constructive feedback.



Answer client questions about their assigned fitness programs.



Participate in scheduled Zoom coaching sessions when required.



Follow up with clients who miss scheduled workouts or check-ins.



Maintain a professional, supportive, and respectful communication style.



Respond to routine client messages within one business day during agreed working coverage.



5. Fitness Coaching Software Management



Maintain accurate client records inside ABC Trainerize or the company's designated coaching platform.



Assign and update approved training programs.



Review workout logs, compliance reports, and progress records.



Upload or organize exercise demonstrations and educational resources.



Maintain clear coaching notes for client continuity.



Use Google Sheets, Google Drive, Zoom, and other approved tools as needed.



6. Client Results & Coaching Quality



Help clients establish realistic, measurable fitness goals.



Identify adherence problems and propose practical solutions.



Maintain consistent coaching standards across assigned clients.



Work collaboratively with the founder on client program adjustments.



Collect client feedback to improve coaching quality.



Document client success stories only with appropriate permission.



Protect client information and maintain confidentiality.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Personal training certification from NASM, ACE, ISSA, ACSM, NSCA, or a comparable recognized organization.



At least 1–2 years of relevant fitness coaching experience preferred.



Solid knowledge of resistance training, progressive overload, fat-loss principles, and exercise technique.



Experience providing personalized accountability and coaching feedback.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based clients.



Strong organizational and time-management skills.



Reliable internet connection and a computer suitable for remote coaching.



Ability to conduct professional Zoom calls.



Willingness to follow established OC360 Fitness coaching standards.



Commitment to client safety, confidentiality, and professional boundaries.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Experience using ABC Trainerize, Everfit, or comparable online coaching software.



Experience coaching men ages 40 and older.



Familiarity with body recomposition, strength development, and training around busy professional schedules.



Previous work with U.S., Canadian, Australian, or international fitness clients.



Experience preparing weekly progress and accountability reports.



Experience with remote fitness coaching or online personal training businesses.



WORK SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



Schedule: Approximately 15 hours weekly.



Monthly Pay: $500–$700 USD, based on qualifications and experience.



Recommended Starting Pay: $600 USD per month.



The initial coaching workload will be limited to an appropriate number of clients based on available hours, service requirements, and coaching complexity.



Compensation and responsibilities will be reviewed after the first 90 days. Additional paid hours may be offered as the coaching business grows.



The position begins part-time, with potential opportunities for expanded responsibilities and leadership.



The final working arrangement, benefits, and payment terms will be established in accordance with applicable employment requirements.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Success in this position will be evaluated through:



Weekly Check-In Completion: Target at least 95% of scheduled client check-ins completed on time.



Client Communication: Respond to routine inquiries within one business day during agreed coverage.



Coaching Accuracy: Maintain properly assigned training programs and accurate records.



Client Accountability: Identify missed workouts and engagement problems promptly.



Client Results: Track measurable client progress toward individualized goals.



Professionalism: Maintain strong communication, confidentiality, and coaching standards.



These targets will be reviewed against actual client workload and available working hours.



FIRST 30 DAYS



The selected candidate will complete a structured onboarding period.



Week 1: Learn the OC360 Fitness brand, coaching philosophy, training system, and client management procedures.



Week 2: Learn the coaching software, review sample client programs, and practice preparing progress reports.



Week 3: Begin assisting with approved client check-ins and program updates under founder supervision.



Week 4: Manage an agreed initial client workload, demonstrate accurate coaching documentation, and participate in a performance review.



CAREER GROWTH: HEAD OF PERFORMANCE



Successful candidates may eventually advance into the position of Head of Performance — OC360 Fitness.



Potential future responsibilities include:



Supervising additional online fitness coaches.



Managing coaching delivery and quality assurance.



Improving OC360 Fitness programming systems.



Monitoring client outcomes across the company.



Training and onboarding new coaches.



Developing scalable coaching procedures.



Reporting coaching performance directly to the founder.



Promotion will depend on demonstrated leadership, coaching quality, business growth, and operational needs.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide the following:



Your resume or professional profile.



Copies or details of your fitness certifications.



A short video introducing yourself in English.



Your previous experience coaching clients online.



A description of your experience with Trainerize or similar software.



Your expected monthly compensation in USD.



Your weekly availability and ability to coordinate with Pacific Time.



An example of how you helped a client improve strength, lose body fat, or maintain workout consistency.



Practical screening question:



A 45-year-old engineering manager trains three times per week but has difficulty following his nutrition plan due to frequent business meetings.



How would you help him improve consistency without overwhelming his schedule?



Please explain your approach in 150–250 words.

We are looking for a dependable, knowledgeable, compassionate, and highly organized fitness professional who wants to build a long-term career with OC360 Fitness.



OC360 FITNESS



Strength Built. Results Driven.

title: Paid Ads Specialist
description:
About the Job



I am looking for an experienced Paid Ads Specialist with strong analytical skills, hands-on campaign management experience, and good English communication skills to join our growing remote marketing team, Engageify Marketing.



This is a full-time, hands-on role for someone who can confidently create, manage, monitor, and optimize paid advertising campaigns that generate qualified leads and deliver measurable results.



I am looking for candidates with actual paid advertising experience, particularly in Google Ads (Search/PPC), YouTube Ads, Google Local Services Ads (LSA), and TikTok Ads. You should understand campaign strategy, audience targeting, budget management, conversion tracking, and performance optimization.



You will support multiple client campaigns, so organization, attention to detail, problem-solving, and the ability to work independently without constant supervision are essential.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to grow with Engageify Marketing, continuously improve their advertising expertise, and take on increasing responsibility as their skills and performance develop.



What You'll Do

1. Paid Advertising Campaign Management

*Create, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, YouTube Ads, Google Local Services Ads, and TikTok Ads.

*Manage Google Search and Pay-Per-Click (PPC) campaigns to generate qualified leads.

*Set up and optimize YouTube skippable in-stream advertising campaigns.

*Manage Google Local Services Ads (LSA), including monitoring lead performance and campaign effectiveness.

*Develop and manage TikTok advertising campaigns based on client objectives.

*Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitor analysis.

*Write, test, and improve ad copy based on campaign performance.

*Manage advertising budgets and monitor spending to ensure alignment with campaign goals.

*Support multiple client accounts while maintaining accurate campaign settings and organization.



2. Campaign Optimization and Performance Tracking

*Monitor campaign performance and identify areas for improvement.

*Set up, verify, and maintain conversion tracking to measure advertising results accurately.

*Conduct A/B testing on ad copy, audiences, keywords, and campaign strategies.

*Analyze key performance indicators, including cost per lead (CPL), cost per click (CPC), click-through rate (CTR), conversion rate, and return on investment (ROI).

*Identify opportunities to improve lead quality, reduce unnecessary advertising costs, and increase campaign efficiency.

*Troubleshoot campaign issues, tracking discrepancies, and performance declines.

*Make data-driven recommendations and implement necessary adjustments.

*Continuously test and refine campaign strategies to improve overall results.



3. Reporting, Communication, and Collaboration

*Prepare clear and accurate campaign performance reports.

*Provide updates on advertising spend, lead generation, campaign results, and areas for improvement.

*Communicate campaign performance, challenges, and recommendations proactively.

*Coordinate with team members to ensure advertising campaigns align with landing pages, funnels, and client objectives.

*Maintain organized campaign records, tracking information, and performance documentation.

*Manage multiple client campaigns, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.

*Participate in team meetings, performance reviews, and strategy discussions.

*Stay updated on advertising platform changes, policies, and industry best practices.

*Apply feedback and continuously improve campaign management and optimization strategies.



The Ideal Candidate Will Have

*Proven hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns, particularly Google Ads Search/PPC.

*Experience with YouTube Ads and TikTok Ads.

*Knowledge of Google Local Services Ads (LSA) and how they support local lead generation.

*A strong understanding of lead generation strategies and campaign performance metrics.

*Experience managing advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns based on measurable results.

*Knowledge of conversion tracking, audience targeting, keyword research, and A/B testing.

*Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.

*Good written and verbal English communication skills.

*Strong attention to detail, especially in campaign setup, budget management, tracking, and reporting.

*The ability to work independently while communicating progress, questions, and challenges proactively.

*Strong organization and time management skills when handling multiple client campaigns.

*A professional attitude toward feedback, accountability, and continuous improvement.

*A reliable computer and stable internet connection.

*A quiet, professional remote work environment.

*Availability for a full-time, long-term remote position.



Preferred Tools and Experience

*Experience with the following will make you a stronger candidate:

*Google Ads Manager and Google Ads Editor.

*Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager.

*Google Local Services Ads (LSA).

*YouTube Ads and TikTok Ads Manager.

*Canva graphic design and basic video editing.

*Social media management, including
, Instagram, and LinkedIn marketing.

*Google Business Profile management and YouTube channel management.

*GoHighLevel (GHL), funnel building, and marketing automation.

*Agency experience or managing advertising campaigns for multiple clients.

*Experience generating leads for U.S.-based businesses.



NOTE: You do not need experience with every tool listed. I place greater importance on proven paid advertising skills, particularly Google Ads, campaign optimization, analytical ability, reliability, communication, and willingness to learn.



However, actual hands-on paid advertising experience is essential. General social media management or organic content creation experience alone is not sufficient for this position.



Candidates should also be comfortable participating in a virtual interview and practical skills assessment. I want to understand how you structure campaigns, manage advertising budgets, analyze performance, troubleshoot issues, and make optimization decisions based on actual campaign data.



How to Apply

Please send the following:

*Your updated résumé or a summary of your relevant work experience.

*Examples of advertising campaigns you have managed, including your responsibilities and measurable results achieved, with confidential client information removed.

*Details about your hands-on experience with Google Ads, YouTube Ads, Google Local Services Ads, and TikTok Ads.

*Information about the advertising budgets you have previously managed.

*A brief explanation of how you typically evaluate and optimize an underperforming campaign.

*Details about your experience with conversion tracking, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools.

*Your current internet speed and computer specifications.

*Confirmation that you are available for a full-time, long-term remote position.

*Confirmation that you are willing to participate in a virtual interview 

*Your availability and earliest possible start date.

*Please include "Paid Ads Specialist" in the subject line of your application.



Applications without relevant hands-on paid advertising experience may not be considered.



Who We Are

Engageify Marketing is a full-service marketing team that helps businesses generate leads, strengthen their brand, and grow through connected marketing systems. We bring together strategy, paid advertising, funnels, CRM, automation, content, creative, and performance tracking so every part of the customer journey works together.We value people who take ownership, think creatively, communicate proactively, and care about doing great work. Our team combines creativity, technical skill, accountability, and continuous improvement to deliver meaningful results for our clients.



To learn more or to apply, contact our Recruiter and Human Resource, Ellizah Palencia at

title: Amazon UK Experienced Online Arbitrage Virtual Assistant
description:
Amazon UK Online Arbitrage Product Researcher / VA – Part-Time



Position: Part-Time Amazon UK Online Arbitrage Product Researcher

Monthly Pay: $300

Location: Remote

Experience: Proven Amazon UK experience required



About the Role



I am looking for an experienced Amazon UK Online Arbitrage (OA) Product Researcher to help identify profitable products to sell through Amazon FBA.



I am looking for someone who understands the UK Amazon marketplace, knows how to research products properly and can consistently find genuine buying opportunities.



Quality over quantity is extremely important. I am not looking for hundreds of random leads. I want carefully researched products that meet the criteria below.



Product Requirements



Products should ideally meet the following criteria:



Net Profit: £5.00+ per unit.



ROI: 30%+.



Profit Margin: Minimum 20%.



Monthly Sales: 50+ estimated units.



FBA Competition: Preferably fewer than 10 FBA sellers.



Stable Buy Box and reliable sales history.



Amazon should ideally not be selling on the listing.



Products should have a sensible level of competition and low risk of price drops.



Products must come from legitimate UK retailers, suppliers or wholesalers.



All profitability calculations must take account of Amazon fees, UK VAT and other relevant costs.



Responsibilities



Research and source profitable Amazon UK OA products.



Use Keepa and SellerAmp SAS to analyse potential products.



Check sales history, Buy Box stability and seller competition.



Calculate net profit, ROI and profit margin accurately.



Check Amazon's presence on listings.



Identify potential IP complaints, restrictions and other selling risks.



Find reliable UK suppliers and provide direct product links.



Record researched products clearly in a Google Sheet.



Requirements



Proven experience sourcing products for Amazon UK.



Good working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp SAS.



Understanding of Amazon FBA fees, UK VAT, ROI and profit calculations.



Experience analysing product sales history and competition.



Good written and spoken English.



Reliable, organised and able to work independently.



Strong attention to detail.



Please do not apply if you have no previous Amazon selling or product-sourcing experience.



How to Apply



To show that you have read the advert, please start your application with the secret word:



SELLER



Please include the following details:



Briefly introduce yourself and explain your Amazon experience.



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon UK, particularly through online arbitrage?



How experienced are you with Keepa and SellerAmp SAS?



Can you provide 2–3 examples of products you have sourced previously, including supplier, purchase price, Amazon selling price, net profit and ROI?



How do you calculate net profit and ROI when accounting for Amazon FBA fees, UK VAT and other costs?



Please answer all five questions clearly.



Further Selection Process



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a short practical product-sourcing test using the criteria in this advert.



The purpose is to assess your actual product-research ability, accuracy and understanding of the Amazon UK marketplace.



I am looking to build a reliable, long-term working relationship with the right person.



Quality over quantity. I want profitable products that can actually be purchased and resold, not just a spreadsheet full of leads.



Looking forward to hearing back from successful applicants

We are looking for an experienced, reliable Virtual Assistant to help manage daily operations across several short-term rental properties in California.



This is an ongoing role supporting our entire portfolio during scheduled work hours. Pay starts at $5 USD per hour, covering all properties—not per property.



Responsibilities:

• Respond promptly and professionally to Airbnb and Vrbo inquiries and guest messages.

• Use Hospitable to manage guest communications, automated messages, reservations, and operational tasks.

• Coordinate cleaners, confirm turnovers, and review property readiness photos before guest arrivals.

• Coordinate maintenance with our local team and follow up until issues are resolved.

• Monitor reservation calendars and identify scheduling problems.

• Manage dynamic pricing using tools such as PriceLabs, Beyond, or Wheelhouse.

• Review rates, occupancy, local demand, upcoming events, and calendar gaps to recommend pricing adjustments.

• Adjust nightly rates, minimum stays, and discounts within owner-approved guidelines.

• Handle guest concerns calmly and enforce property rules professionally.

• Track maintenance needs, supplies, and outstanding tasks.

• Send a brief daily report covering arrivals, departures, and unresolved issues.

• Escalate emergencies immediately and obtain owner approval for refunds, cancellations, and major expenses.



Requirements:

• At least one year of direct experience supporting Airbnb or Vrbo hosts.

• Hands-on experience with Hospitable, including messaging automation and reservation management.

• Experience using dynamic pricing software such as PriceLabs, Beyond, or Wheelhouse.

• Understanding of occupancy, average daily rate, minimum-stay settings, and pricing strategies.

• Experience coordinating cleaners and managing multiple properties.

• Excellent written English, organization, and follow-through.

• Reliable internet with a backup connection.

• Availability for agreed Pacific Time shifts, including some weekend coverage.

• Ability to work independently and recognize when owner approval is needed.



Airbnb customer support experience is welcome. Please distinguish that experience from directly managing properties for a host.



Schedule:

Approximately 40 hours per week. Exact shifts and days off will be agreed before hiring. You are expected to be responsive during your scheduled hours; this is not a 24/7 on-call position.



To apply, please provide:



Your relevant experience and how many properties you have supported at once.



Your experience with Airbnb, Vrbo, and Hospitable.



Which dynamic pricing tools you have used and how you d
 when to adjust rates.



Your availability in Pacific Time and any overlapping client commitments.



How you would handle a cleaner not showing up two hours before check-in.



A reference who can verify your work.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and a paid practical trial.

title: Virtual Assistant — Social Media & Lead Generation for Naytira's Rentals
description:
Virtual Assistant — Social Media & Lead Generation

Naytira's Rentals — 360 photo booth, mirror photo booth, and keepsake station for keychains.



Help a growing photo booth company stay visible online and turn holiday-season interest — especially from corporate clients — into real bookings.



Type: Part-time, Remote — Virtual Assistant

Hours: 15 hours per week, flexible schedule

Pay: $4.00 per hour, plus a $20 bonus for every lead secured

Start: As soon as possible

Employment type: Independent contractor



About Naytira's Rentals



Naytira's Rentals is a photo booth rental company that helps guests make and keep memories at parties, weddings, school and community events, and corporate celebrations. Clients can book a 360 photo booth or a mirror photo booth, and add a keepsake station that turns guests' photos into keychains they take home. We are a small, hands-on business. That means your work will be seen, your ideas will be heard, and good work will show up directly in inquiries and bookings — not disappear into a big team.



Why this role, why now



We are at the start of the holiday season — the busiest time of year for company holiday parties, end-of-year celebrations, and staff appreciation events. Companies are choosing entertainment now, and they often find and judge vendors on social media first. We need someone consistent and proactive who will keep us posting, keep us engaging, and actively reach out to corporate prospects while demand is high. After the holidays, the same work carries into weddings, birthdays, graduations, and events year-round.



What you will do



1. Social Media Management



Plan and maintain a simple weekly content calendar for our social media accounts, so we post consistently without last-minute scrambling. Create, schedule, and publish posts, Reels / short videos, and Stories using photos and video from real events — 360 booth clips, mirror booth moments, and keepsake station photos. Write clear, friendly captions in our voice, with relevant hashtags and a clear call to action (check a date, send a message, request a quote). Repurpose our best event content: turn one event into several posts, highlight reels, and seasonal promotions. Engage daily: reply to comments and direct messages promptly, thank clients and vendors who tag us, and flag any inquiry that needs a fast personal reply. Keep profiles current — bio, highlights, pinned posts, booking links, and holiday availability / offer posts. Track what works each week (reach, saves, shares, profile visits, and inquiries) and suggest what to do more or less of.



2. Lead Generation & Corporate Outreach



Research and build targeted lead lists: local companies, offices, HR and office managers, event planners, venues, schools, and organizations likely to host holiday and corporate events. Send thoughtful outreach by
 and social media using approved templates — and personalize each message; no mass spam. Follow up politely and persistently on schedule, so interested prospects do not go cold. Monitor and respond to leads on Bark and any other listing or inquiry platforms we use, keeping response times fast. Qualify each lead before handing it over: event date, type of event, location, estimated guest count, which booth they want, and contact details. Keep a clean, up-to-date lead tracker: source, contact, date contacted, follow-ups, status, and next step for every prospect. Report weekly on outreach sent, replies, qualified leads secured, and dates handed over for booking.



What you will also help with



Inbox support: Sort social and
 inquiries, draft replies for approval, and make sure no inquiry sits unanswered. Review and referral requests: Message past clients after events to thank them, request a review, and ask about upcoming events. Vendor connections: Engage with venues, planners, DJs, and caterers online and note partnership or referral opportunities. Light admin: Organize event photos and videos, name and file content so it is easy to reuse, and keep our lead and content trackers tidy.



Pay highlight — lead bonus: You will earn a $20 bonus whenever you secure a lead, on top of your base pay. Good outreach is directly rewarded here, because leads are the point of this role.



What success looks like



In your first 30 days — what we expect to see:

Social media: Profiles cleaned up and current, a weekly content calendar running, and consistent posting using our existing event photos and videos.

Lead generation: A lead tracker set up, a first targeted list of corporate and holiday-event prospects built, and outreach and follow-up underway.

Communication: A short weekly update: what was posted, who was contacted, what replies came in, and which leads were secured.



By 60 days, success is a steady rhythm — consistent content, no lead left without a follow-up, and a visible flow of qualified inquiries for holiday and upcoming events. We care more about inquiries and secured leads than follower counts alone.



You must have



- Experience managing social media for a business, brand, or client — please be ready to show examples.

- Experience with lead generation, outreach, sales support, or customer follow-up.

- Strong, friendly written English for captions, messages, and
s.

- Confidence creating short-form content (Reels / TikTok-style video, Stories) from phone photos and clips.

- Organization you can prove: you keep trackers, lists, and follow-up dates accurate without being chased.

- Reliability: you work your agreed hours, meet posting and follow-up deadlines, and communicate early if something will be late.

- A phone or computer, reliable internet, and comfort working remotely.



Nice to have



- Experience in events, weddings, hospitality, or entertainment.

- Experience finding corporate clients or working business-to-business (B2B) leads.

- Experience with Bark or similar lead / marketplace platforms.

- Basic design and editing skills in Canva, CapCut, or similar tools.

- Familiarity with Meta Business Suite or another scheduling tool.



Tools you will use



Instagram and
 (Meta Business Suite). Canva and a short-video editor such as CapCut. Google Sheets or similar for the lead tracker.
 and direct messages for outreach. Bark for inbound leads.



How to apply



Please send your application to 
 with the subject line "Virtual Assistant — Naytira's Rentals". Please include:

- A short introduction: who you are, where you are based, and why this role fits you.

- Links to 2-3 social media accounts or posts you have managed or created.

- One short example of an outreach message you would send to a company planning a holiday party.

- A brief note on how you have found or followed up leads before, and the tools you used.

- Your availability for 15 hours per week and your earliest start date.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a small sample task: draft three social media captions and list ten local corporate prospects you would contact first, with a one-line reason for each.



We will reply to applicants whose experience matches what we need. Thank you for applying.

title: Long-form YouTube Editor (Premiere Pro) for a Foot Health Education Channel
description:
Hi, I'm Paul. I'm a UK trained podiatrist based in Singapore, and I run a YouTube channel that helps people choose the right shoes and look after their feet. You can see my channel here: 



I'm looking for a long-form editor to edit 4 to 6 YouTube videos a month, each around 8 to 12 minutes.



WHAT THE WORK IS

- We film everything in Singapore: A-roll (me talking to camera, more than one angle) and B-roll, shot to the script. You get organised footage in Google Drive.

- You choose the best takes and camera angles, cut for pace, and build the edit.

- You add graphics to explain steps and key points, clear text on screen for the important messages, and clean sound and music.

- You upload drafts to 
. I give notes, you revise. Up to 2 rounds per video.

- Turnaround is 5 days from footage to first draft.



THE STYLE

Clean, educational explainer videos. Think Ali Abdaal: clear on-screen text, simple graphics that make a point land, good pacing, nothing distracting. Watch my uploads from January to November 2026 to see where the style is now. I'm happy for you to improve on it.



WHAT YOU NEED

- At least 3 years editing in Premiere Pro, including YouTube long-form

- Your own Premiere Pro licence

- Experience with motion graphics or animated text in your edits

- 
 experience, or willing to learn it before your first video

- Good written and spoken English

- Reliable internet and enough time for 4 to 6 videos a month



NICE TO HAVE

- After Effects

- You already use AI tools in your editing, or want to learn. We'd like to use Claude and HyperFrames for motion graphics, and will support you to learn them.



WHAT I'M REALLY LOOKING FOR

Someone who sees editing as a craft and wants each video to be better than the last. I give clear, honest feedback and I expect you to use it.



PAY

US$60 to US$85 per video, depending on experience. Paid per video once the final edit is approved.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your subject line with the words FOOT PAIN EDITOR. Applications without it won't be read.

2. Answer every question below in your message.

3. Shortlisted applicants will be asked to do a paid test edit (US$25): editing the 3 minute intro of one of my videos from raw A-roll and B-roll. You won't be asked to edit a full video as a test.



QUESTIONS (please answer every one)

1. How many years have you edited in Premiere Pro? How many of those editing YouTube long-form?

2. Share links to 3 long-form YouTube videos you edited. For each, tell us what you did (full edit, graphics only, etc.).

3. Share one video you edited at least 2 years ago and one from this year. What's the biggest thing that changed in your editing?

4. Do you have your own Premiere Pro licence? Have you used 
 for client review?

5. Do you add motion graphics to your edits? Which tools do you use (After Effects, Premiere graphics, HyperFrames, other)? Link one example.

6. Watch this video of mine: 
. Name one thing that works well and one thing you'd change, and why.

7. Do you use AI in your editing or graphics? Which tools, and what for? If not, would you be willing to learn Claude and HyperFrames?

8. What are you learning right now to improve your editing?

9. Take the free EF SET English test (
, the 50 minute version) and paste your certificate link.

10. Record a 1 minute video introducing yourself in English and share the link (unlisted YouTube, Loom or Google Drive). Also confirm you can commit to 4 to 6 videos a month with a 5 day turnaround.
