title: Outbound Appointment Setter (Property, UK Hours)
description:
Outbound Appointment Setter (Property, UK Hours)

Full-time

Salary: £4 per hour during the three-month probation, £5 per hour after. At 40 paid hours a week, that comes to approximately £693 per month during probation and approximately £867 per month after.



ABOUT THE COMPANY



A UK-based property education and mentoring business supporting people who want to invest in property. The team is fully remote across the UK, Spain, South Africa and the Philippines, with a long-tenured group of virtual assistants, several of them three years and over.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a phone-first outbound role. You'll be calling people who have already registered interest in property investing, qualifying them, and booking them into discovery calls and webinars. You qualify and book only. You don't close.



Please read that again before applying. This is not customer service, not inbound support, and not a closing role. You will be dialing for most of your shift, every shift.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



• Calling leads interested in property education and investment, around 80 calls a day

• Building rapport, qualifying interest, and booking discovery calls or webinars

• Handling objections and completing up to five follow-up attempts per lead

• Confirming appointments and helping maintain attendance rates

• Logging every call outcome, status, and follow-up task in GoHighLevel accurately and on time

• Managing your own calling rhythm through the shift with minimal supervision



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• Proven outbound calling experience with numbers you can actually quote: daily dials, connect rate, and bookings per week

• A clear answer to what makes a lead worth booking and what doesn't. Qualification is the job, not just getting someone to agree to a time slot

• GoHighLevel experience. This is the core platform and you'll be working in it from day one

• Disciplined after-call work. Logging outcomes correctly and on time is as much of the job as the calls themselves

• Self-managed pace. Nobody will be standing over you telling you to dial, so you need to keep momentum through the shift

• Comfortable being measured daily on call volume, connect rate, and bookings

• Someone who asks questions, speaks up in team meetings, and raises issues early rather than going quiet

• Strong spoken English and the resilience to handle rejection without taking it personally

• Reliable setup: own computer, stable internet, backup power and internet, quiet dedicated workspace



NICE TO HAVE



• Experience calling into property, real estate, coaching, or education

• Previous UK-hours experience



SCHEDULE AND TERMS



• Full-time, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM UK time (7:00 PM to 4:00 AM Manila), including a one-hour unpaid break

• £4 per hour during the three-month probation, £5 per hour after

• Approximately £693 per month during probation, approximately £867 per month after

• Paid monthly, on the first Wednesday. Not weekly, not twice monthly

• Time tracked via Time Doctor

• Two weeks of paid training before you start calling, mostly self-paced

• Long-term, remote, independent contractor basis



HOW TO APPLY



Complete this short application form, it takes about two minutes:



Applications that skip the form won't be reviewed.

title: Social Media & AI Virtual Assistant
description:
# Social Media & AI Virtual Assistant (Part-Time, 20 Hours/Week)



**Creative Thinker | AI-Savvy | Strong English | US Eastern Time**



We're looking for a creative, proactive, and tech-savvy Social Media Virtual Assistant to join our growing video marketing company.



We work with entrepreneurs, coaches, consultants, speakers, and professional service businesses to help them get more visible, build authority, and attract clients through video and social media.



We create a LOT of content, and we need someone who can help us turn that content into a consistent, engaging social media presence for both our company and our clients.



**We're not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions. We're looking for someone who brings ideas, takes initiative, and enjoys being part of a creative team.**



 What You'll Be Doing



- Managing and scheduling social media content across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other platforms as needed.

- Writing compelling captions, hooks, and social media posts that sound natural and engaging.

- Working with our video production team to turn existing video content into social media campaigns.

- Helping organize and manage multiple client social media accounts.

- Using AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to brainstorm content, improve workflows, and work more efficiently.

- Collaborating with our editors and team members to keep content moving from production to publication.

- Helping develop content calendars and suggesting new ideas to improve engagement and visibility.

- Monitoring published content, checking quality, and helping track performance.

- Learning and using GoHighLevel to manage and schedule social media content.



### What We're Looking For



**Excellent English communication skills.** You must be an excellent English writer and a confident verbal communicator. You'll be writing for US-based businesses, so understanding natural American English is essential.



**AI-forward mindset.** You should already be comfortable using AI tools, especially Claude and ChatGPT, and be genuinely excited about learning how to use AI to do better, more creative work. We're looking for someone who thinks beyond basic prompting.



**Social media experience.** You should understand how content works across different platforms, including what makes a good hook, caption, short-form video, and engaging post.



**Creativity and initiative.** We want your ideas! If you see an opportunity to improve something, speak up. If you have a better way to do something, we'd love to hear it.



**Organization and attention to detail.** You'll be working with multiple projects and accounts, so keeping things organized, accurate, and on schedule is important.



**Strong teamwork.** You'll be collaborating with a small, friendly, hardworking team. Communication, reliability, and a positive attitude matter.



**Reliable technology.** You must have a dependable computer, excellent high-speed internet, and a professional environment for video meetings.



### Bonus Skills (Not Required)



- Experience with GoHighLevel, especially its Social Planner and sub-account management.

- Experience with Canva, CapCut, or similar creative tools.

- Experience managing social media for multiple clients or agencies.

- Familiarity with video marketing and content repurposing.

- Experience creating AI-assisted content workflows or automations.



Don't worry if you don't know GoHighLevel yet. We're happy to train the right person.



### Schedule & Opportunity



**Hours:** Approximately 20 hours per week to start, with the opportunity to grow.



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, approximately 4 hours per day, with availability during US Eastern Time business hours.



**Location:** Remote, Philippines.



We're looking for someone interested in building a long-term relationship with our company. As we grow, there's potential for additional hours, responsibilities, and opportunities.



### How to Apply



Please send us the following:



1. **Your portfolio.** Show us examples of social media accounts you've managed, content you've created, or campaigns you've helped execute. Please explain what YOU personally contributed.

2. **A short introduction.** Tell us about your experience and why you think you'd be a great fit.

3. **Your AI experience.** Tell us how you're currently using Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools in your work. We'd especially love to hear about something you've created or improved with AI.

4. **Your availability and desired hourly rate.**

5. **Your internet speed** and whether you have backup internet access.



**One final question:** If you joined our team and noticed that we were sitting on dozens of great videos that weren't being used on social media, what are the first three things you'd suggest doing?



We're excited to find someone who loves social media, enjoys technology, and wants to help us build something great together!

title: Operations & Sales Manager – US Cleaning Company (BookingKoala)
description:
We’re a growing residential and commercial cleaning company in Palm Beach County, Florida, USA. We’re hiring an experienced Operations & Sales Manager to run our day-to-day operations and turn our leads into booked, paying customers.



This is not a basic admin role. We want someone who takes ownership, follows up without being reminded, and keeps the schedule full and running smoothly.



SCHEDULE: US Eastern business hours. Exact hours will be agreed with the right candidate.



SALES – What you’ll do



-Respond to new leads fast (calls, texts, website forms,
 ads), ideally within 5 minutes



-Send quotes and follow up until the customer books or says no



-Turn one-time customers into recurring (weekly/biweekly/monthly) clients



-Offer add-ons (inside fridge, oven, cabinets, blinds) when they fit the customer



-Win back past customers who haven’t booked in a while



-Track every lead and its status in our CRM



OPERATIONS – What you’ll do



-Manage scheduling and dispatching in BookingKoala (bookings, reschedules, cancellations, cleaner assignments)



-Communicate with our cleaners every day (confirmations, job details, call-outs, last-minute changes)



-Answer customer calls, texts and
s professionally, and handle complaints with care



-Follow up on payments, declined cards and cancellation fees



-Do quality control check-ins after cleans and send review requests to happy customers



REQUIREMENTS



-2+ years of VA experience in sales and/or operations. Cleaning or home-service experience is strongly preferred



-Comfortable on the phone and confident following up with leads



-BookingKoala experience is a big plus (GoHighLevel, Stripe and QuickBooks are a bonus)



-Excellent written and spoken English



-Reliable internet and a backup plan for power outages



-Organized, proactive and calm under pressure



DETAILS



-Part-time to start (20–30 hrs/week), with room to grow to full-time

-2-week paid trial at your full hourly rate, with clear goals. If it’s a good fit, we move to a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY (applications missing any of these won’t be reviewed)



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Start your message with the words “Spotless Schedule” so we know you read the full post.



Include:



A 2–3 minute video introduction (Loom or Google Drive link). Tell us about yourself, your sales and operations experience, and the tools you’ve used



Your resume



A screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net)



Your answers to these two questions:



“A cleaner calls out sick at 7 AM and has a 9 AM deep clean. What do you do, step by step?”



“A lead got a quote 3 days ago and hasn’t replied. Write the text message you would send them.”



We look forward to meeting you!

title: Strategic Partnerships & Business Development Representative ( Remote)_
description:
Company: Baloom & Co.  

Location: Ottawa–Gatineau , Ontario, Canada 

Role Type: Part-time, contract or gig -based (to be determined)  

Industry: Event Décor, Balloon Arrangements & Celebrations



About Baloom & Co.



Baloom & Co. is an event décor business specializing in personalized balloon arrangements, balloon arches, backdrops and decorative installations for private celebrations and corporate events.



Our motto: Made Personal. Made Memorable.



We collaborate with individuals, businesses and event professionals to create visually memorable experiences.



Position Overview



We are seeking a motivated and relationship-oriented Strategic Partnerships & Business Development Representative to identify, approach and develop collaborations with businesses across Ottawa and Gatineau.



The ideal candidate is confident communicating with business owners, event planners and decision-makers, and enjoys building long-term professional relationships.



The primary objective is to develop a reliable network of referral partners, preferred vendors and event-package collaborators who can generate recurring business opportunities.



Key Responsibilities



1. Partnership Prospecting

- Identify and research potential business partners.

- Build and maintain a database of qualified businesses.

- Identify decision-makers and establish first contact.

- Prioritize businesses with recurring event-related customer demand.



2. Business Outreach

- Conduct phone calls,
s, social media outreach and in-person visits.

- Introduce Baloom & Co. and explain potential collaboration benefits.

- Schedule discovery calls and partnership meetings.

- Follow up consistently with prospects.



3. Partnership Development

- Explore referral arrangements and preferred-vendor relationships.

- Propose joint event packages and promotional collaborations.

- Identify co-marketing and cross-promotion opportunities.

- Negotiate proposed commercial terms for management approval.



4. Relationship Management

- Maintain communication with active partners.

- Share seasonal offers and updated décor packages.

- Coordinate opportunities with the Baloom & Co. operations team.

- Gather partner feedback and identify additional opportunities.



5. Reporting & CRM

- Maintain accurate prospect and partnership records.

- Track outreach activities, meetings, opportunities and confirmed referrals.

- Provide weekly pipeline and performance updates.



Ideal Candidate



- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Experience in sales, outreach, events or relationship management.

- Comfortable making cold calls and approaching local businesses.

- Organized and capable of managing follow-up activities.

- Familiar with social media and basic CRM tools.

- Knowledge of Ottawa–Gatineau's event industry is an asset.

- English and French communication skills are an asset.



Key Performance Indicators



- 40–60 new businesses contacted weekly.

- 8–12 qualified conversations weekly.

- 3–5 partnership meetings booked weekly.

- 2–4 new partnership agreements per month after initial ramp-up.

- Consistent tracking of referrals, bookings and partner-generated revenue.



These are proposed performance targets, not guaranteed outcomes.



Compensation



Compensation may consist of an agreed hourly/base amount, performance bonuses, commissions on attributable partnership-generated revenue, or an appropriate combination.



The final structure will depend on the employment or contractor arrangement and applicable legal requirements.



 Success in This Role



Success means building sustainable, revenue-generating partnerships that position Baloom & Co. as a trusted event décor supplier throughout Ottawa and Gatineau.

title: Short-Form Video Creator & Viral Reels Specialist
description:
Instinctive Branding is a 15-year-old US based marketing agency seeking an exceptionally talented creative, results-driven, and detail-oriented Short-Form Video Creator who knows how to turn ideas and raw footage into engaging videos that capture attention, drive engagement and viral works be heat too.



This role is perfect for someone who understands more than just video editing. We’re looking for someone who knows how to create compelling hooks, tell stories through video, follow trends, and develop content that people want to watch, share, and engage with.



If you have created Reels that went viral or generated impressive organic views, we want to see your work!



Key Responsibilities

    •    Create and edit engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and
.

    •    Transform raw footage, interviews, and existing content into compelling short videos.

    •    Develop attention-grabbing hooks that capture viewers within the first 1–3 seconds.

    •    Add captions, transitions, music, sound effects, B-roll, and other creative elements.

    •    Research viral content, trending formats, and relevant audio to generate new ideas.

    •    Repurpose long-form content into multiple short-form videos.

    •    Follow brand guidelines and maintain visual consistency across client accounts.

    •    Collaborate with the team to brainstorm content ideas and improve video performance.

    •    Review available analytics and recommend ways to improve engagement and audience retention.

    •    Meet deadlines and manage video projects according to established content calendars and trackers.



Required Skills

    •    Advanced video editing skills using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, or similar tools.

    •    Proven experience creating Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, or other short-form videos.

    •    Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing, captions, and audience retention.

    •    Ability to identify trends and adapt them to different brands and audiences.

    •    Excellent attention to detail and a strong sense of visual storytelling.

    •    Ability to follow creative briefs, brand guidelines, and feedback.

    •    Comfortable using AI tools to support content research, ideation, scripting, and editing workflows.

    •    Ability to manage tasks independently and consistently meet deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications

    •    Previous experience as a Video Editor, Social Media Manager, or Content Creator.

    •    Experience creating videos that achieved high organic reach or went viral.

    •    Understanding of social media analytics, including views, watch time, shares, saves, and engagement.

    •    Experience editing talking-head videos, interviews, podcasts, educational content, or promotional videos.

    •    Ability to suggest creative concepts, write hooks, and improve existing video ideas.

    •    Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who is creative, curious, and proactive. Someone who doesn't simply follow instructions but can also bring fresh ideas to the table.

Our ideal candidate:

    •    Understands what makes people stop scrolling.

    •    Can explain why a video performed well and how to apply those lessons to future content.

    •    Is comfortable experimenting with different hooks, formats, and editing styles.

    •    Takes ownership of their work and pays attention to the little details.

    •    Is organized, reliable, and open to constructive feedback.

    •    Can work independently while collaborating with a creative team.

    •    Focuses on creating effective content, not just making videos look good.



Show Us Your Viral Reels!

This is an important part of your application. Without this, we aren’t interested. 

We want to see what you've actually created and how your videos performed.



Please include:

    •    Links to at least 3–5 Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts you personally created.

    •    Links to at least 2–3 of your best-performing videos, preferably those with high organic views.

    •    The view counts and engagement results for your strongest videos.

    •    A brief explanation of your role in each video, including whether you handled editing, scripting, concept development, filming, or the entire production.

    •    One example of a video you believe performed particularly well and a short explanation of why you think it succeeded.



Please be transparent about your individual contribution, especially if you worked as part of a team. We value genuine experience, creative thinking, and the ability to learn from performance data.



We're not expecting every video to go viral. We're looking for someone who understands what makes content effective and knows how to keep improving it.



Values We Admire

    •    Creativity in approach and problem-solving.

    •    Team players who collaborate well.

    •    Honest and transparent communication.

    •    Kindness and consideration toward others.

    •    Accountability and pride in delivering quality work.

    •    A positive attitude and someone who's fun to work with, even on Zoom!



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

    1    Your resume.

    2    A brief introduction about yourself and your video editing experience.

    3    Your portfolio with direct links to your best videos.

    4    Examples of high-performing or viral Reels, including view counts and engagement results.

    5    A brief explanation of what made one of your videos successful.

    6    The editing tools and AI tools you use.



Please change the subject line of your application to: "Look No Further! Great videos here.”

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a brief interview and a small editing test using footage provided by our team.

Please note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



We're excited to meet you if you’re ready to bring creativity, strong editing skills, and a results-driven mindset to our team!

description:
Hiring: Head of Offshore Operations



Location: Philippines (Remote)

We are launching a U.S.-based international staffing company and are looking for an experienced operations manager to help build and oversee our overseas workforce.

title: Spanish-Speaking Medical Virtual Assistant
description:
• Pay: USD 750 a month base, plus performance incentives with no cap. Our top performers take home USD 1,300 to 1,500 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 7 AM in Manila), with some weekend shifts for coverage

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home

• Languages: fluent spoken Spanish and English. You call patients in both.



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

Your first call of the day is to a woman in her sixties with COPD who speaks only Spanish. Her health system referred her to us last week. She asks how you got her number, and says her daughter usually deals with her doctors. In Spanish, you explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit. Your next call is in English.



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. Many of them speak Spanish. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit. For a patient who speaks Spanish, you are the first person at AnsibleHealth they can talk to in their own language.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voicemail, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Your job is to help each one decide whether to join, and to get them to a first visit within a week or so. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team.



WHAT YOU NEED



• Fluent spoken Spanish that a Spanish-speaking patient in the US understands the first time, including medicine names, numbers and times

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions

• A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages

• Availability for this shift for the long term

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or calls handled in Spanish at work are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or email work. If you like talking with people and helping them say yes to care, you will do well here.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 20 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at https://www.ansiblehealth.com/careers/jobs/spanish-speaking-medical-virtual-assistant/apply?ref=vtk2amhw . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions in English.

3. Complete the Spanish section of the form. Its instructions are below, in Spanish only.

4. Record your voice on the form, first in English and then in Spanish. Each time you read three lines from a real call, then answer a patient in your own words (about ten minutes in all).

5. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.



EN ESPAÑOL

Esta parte del anuncio está solo en español, a propósito: en este trabajo usted llama a pacientes que hablan español. En la solicitud le pedimos tres cosas en español:



1. Escribir la palabra clave. Cuando el formulario le pida la palabra clave, escriba GIRASOL.

2. Responder por escrito una pregunta breve.

3. Grabar su voz: leer tres frases de una llamada real y responderle a una paciente con sus propias palabras.



If you are shortlisted, we email you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

title: YouTube Scriptwriter and Recording Outline Writer - Research provided
description:
⚠️ PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING:



Please read the full post before applying. We’re looking for someone who understands the role.

If you’ve read this, start your application with “I READ THE BRIEF” and follow the instructions under How to Apply.

Applications that don’t follow the instructions may not be considered.



—



YouTube Scriptwriter and Recording Outline Writer

Research provided



I’m Shane, the creator behind Repzilla. I’m looking for a writer to turn my research into engaging recording scripts and outlines for long-form commentary and documentary videos.



I supply labeled clips, screenshots, links, research notes, and the intended angle. You organize that material into a story I can follow naturally while recording, develop the reasoning, and write the connections between sections.





WHAT YOU WILL CREATE:



- A complete recording document with short scripted introductions, explanations, and transitions where useful.



- Original research labels and clickable links at the point of use, with relevant timestamps and playback or cutoff instructions.



- Concise commentary prompts such as “go over” or “read & react,” with more developed points when the reasoning needs explanation.



- Occasional editor notes for visuals, cuts, and B-roll, plus a short list of unresolved questions.





Preserve the original research labels exactly. You may arrange sources in any order that serves the story, and the same label must be reused when returning to the same source. I use those labels to search my research and find what to open next.



The writing should fit each moment. Develop complex explanations and leave room for natural reactions. Handle supplied evidence accurately, preserve relevant context and responses, and flag unsupported conclusions or missing material. Additional investigation is scoped separately.



Videos may run around 60 minutes or longer when the material supports it. Estimate speaking and clip playback separately; avoid padding the story to reach a runtime. Maine coordinates assignments and feedback, and I provide editorial approval.





HOW TO APPLY:



Send two relevant scripts or recording outlines, preferably with the finished videos, and explain which parts you created. 



Include your availability, expected turnaround, and quote after reviewing a sample research packet.



Shortlisted candidates will receive a format example and complete a paid test for a section estimated at 5–8 minutes of finished video. 



We agree on scope, fee, deadline, and any included revision in advance. 



Completed tests are paid regardless of selection. Be prepared to explain your story order and show how a claim connects to its source.

title: Creator Outreach Assistant
description:
Hiring: Creator Outreach Assistant | Travel & Expat Community



Remote | Part-Time | Contract | $5 USD per Hour



Help Us Build a Global Travel Community



Are you someone who enjoys watching travel YouTubers, discovering interesting people, and learning about life in different countries?



Do you love hearing stories about people who packed their bags, moved abroad, and completely changed their lives?



If so, we’d love to hear from you!



VoyaKin is looking for a friendly, organized, and detail-oriented Creator Outreach Assistant to help us connect with travel creators, expats, and people sharing their experiences of living abroad.



This isn’t a traditional sales job. You’ll be helping us introduce people to a growing travel community built around exploration, belonging, and meaningful human connections.



About VoyaKin



VoyaKin (
) is a brand-new, African American-owned travel community platform for iPhone, Android, and the web.



Founded by Darius Henry and owned by Stockhouse Films, VoyaKin was created around one powerful idea:



“Belong Somewhere, Not Just Go Somewhere.”



Our mission is to help people discover what’s possible beyond their home country, challenge misconceptions about international travel, and connect with others who have already experienced life abroad.



VoyaKin brings together country-based communities called Circles, travel guides, trip planning, social feeds, messaging with translation, and verified travel passports.



Our initial Circles include Ghana, Thailand, Vietnam, Mexico, Costa Rica, Colombia, Portugal, South Africa, Kenya, Panama, Senegal, Brazil, The Gambia, Tanzania, and Indonesia.



The app is free for travelers, and we’re currently in an early launch and beta phase.



What You’ll Be Doing



1. Discover Interesting Travel Creators



* Search YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok for people who document traveling, relocating, retiring, or living abroad.

* Focus especially on African American and diaspora creators, while welcoming authentic travel experiences from all backgrounds.

* Use our built-in Creator Finder to discover relevant channels.

* Review creator profiles, engagement, content, and AI-generated fit scores.

* Add qualified creators to our Creator CRM, avoiding duplicates.



2. Research Each Creator



* Claim creators from our shared outreach pool to avoid duplicate contact.

* Use our AI-powered Research & Draft tool to understand their background and travel journey.

* Watch or review relevant videos to understand their experiences.

* Identify what makes each person’s story interesting and relevant to VoyaKin.



3. Send Personalized Invitations



* Invite suitable creators to explore VoyaKin as founding members or ambassadors for their country’s Circle.

* Start with AI-generated outreach drafts and improve them with genuine personal details.

* Write warm, friendly, professional messages that sound human.

* Contact creators through publicly available business
s, Instagram DMs, or other appropriate public contact methods.

* Personally review and send every message. Outreach is never sent automatically.



4. Manage Conversations and Follow-Ups



* Record outreach activity and responses in our built-in CRM.

* Track creators through stages from Found and Contacted to Interested and Joined VoyaKin.

* Follow up politely when appropriate, typically after five days, with a maximum of two follow-ups.

* Respect requests not to be contacted.

* Keep claimed creators active; inactive claims return to the shared pool after seven days.



5. Help Build Relationships



* Respond to basic questions about VoyaKin.

* Share early-access information when appropriate.

* Introduce interested creators to the founder for next steps.

* Provide feedback about which outreach approaches generate meaningful conversations.



6. Help Creators Become Active Community Members



* Guide interested creators through signing up for VoyaKin.

* Encourage new members to introduce themselves and share their first authentic travel-related post.

* Help creators discover and participate in their relevant country Circles.

* Follow up with newly registered creators when appropriate to answer questions or offer assistance.

* Track registrations, first posts, and community participation in the available admin tools.

* Share feedback about obstacles that prevent creators from joining or participating.



Our Goal Is Real Community Growth



Success isn’t measured simply by how many creators you contact. Our goal is to bring real travelers and content creators into VoyaKin who genuinely want to participate in our community.



You’ll help guide interested creators from their initial invitation through registration and their first post.



Our initial monthly targets are:



* 5–10 new creator registrations on VoyaKin.

* 3–6 registered creators publishing their first original post.



These goals will be reviewed and adjusted based on actual outreach results.



We value genuine engagement, meaningful relationships, and quality content over inflated numbers or spam.



We want creators to join because they believe in what we’re building, not because they feel pressured to register or publish content.



Tools You’ll Use



You’ll work primarily inside the VoyaKin admin dashboard.



Our system includes:



* Creator Finder

* AI-assisted creator research and message drafting

* Creator CRM and recruitment pipeline

* Outreach tracking and follow-up reminders

* Personal activity tracking



You’ll also use YouTube, Instagram, TikTok,
, and social messaging.



Training is provided. No coding or technical development experience is required.



Your admin access is limited to outreach functions. You will not have access to app users’ private information, private messages, payments, advertising, or administrative settings. Actions within the admin system are logged.



Who We’re Looking For



We’re especially interested in someone who:



* Has excellent written English and communicates naturally.

* Enjoys researching people, cultures, and travel experiences.

* Understands how YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok work.

* Is organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.

* Can manage multiple conversations without losing track.

* Follows instructions and works independently.

* Understands that quality matters more than sending hundreds of generic messages.

* Respects privacy, platform guidelines, and people’s decisions.



Nice to Have, but Not Required



* Previous experience in influencer outreach, virtual assistance, or community management.

* Familiarity with international travel, expats, or digital nomad communities.

* Experience using CRM systems.

* Knowledge of African American travel communities or the African diaspora.

* Additional language skills, especially French, Spanish, Portuguese, Thai, or Vietnamese.



How We’ll Measure Success



We care about meaningful connections, not just message volume.



Performance indicators include:



* [x] new qualified creators identified weekly

* [x] personalized messages sent weekly

* Creator response rates

* 5–10 new creator registrations monthly

* 3–6 creators publishing their first original post monthly

* Continued participation from recruited creators

* Accurate and current CRM records

* Professional communication and consistent follow-through



Targets will be adjustable as we learn what works best.



Position Details



Company: VoyaKin



Website: 



Location: Remote



Employment type: Part-time / Contract



Hours: 20–30 hours per week



Compensation: $5 USD per hour



Start date: ASAP



Our Values



We believe in honesty, authenticity, and treating people with respect.



We never exaggerate our platform’s size, pressure creators, purchase contact lists, scrape private information, or send mass-produced spam.



Every creator deserves thoughtful, personal communication.



We’d love to meet someone who wants to help introduce people to an amazing world of travel, cultural discovery, and global friendships.



VoyaKin — Belong Somewhere, Not Just Go Somewhere.

Your experience sourcing and managing creators, videographers, and editors.



How you'd approach creative strategy differently for Above versus KAEN.



Your hourly/monthly rate and availability.

title: Acquisitions Agent — Land Flipping / Wholesaling (Work From Home)
description:
GM Capital buys vacant land in the USA. We are looking for a hardworking acquisitions agent to call land sellers, follow up, and get purchase contracts signed. You will make a lot of calls every day, working through the CRM, nurturing leads, following up with sellers, and comping lots. 

We are looking for a hardworking, disciplined person who stays focused and consistent every shift.What we do is pretty straightforward. It is a volume game: we buy land at a discounted price, so your job is to get a lot of fair, discounted offers out to sellers every day and follow up until they sign. There is not a lot of hard negotiating — the process is simple, the numbers are set, and success comes from volume and follow-up, not from long, complicated deals.

This is a long-term job. We will train you on our system, our scripts, and our tools.



What You Will Do:

Work in our CRM every day and keep all leads organized and updated

Make a lot of calls every day to land sellers in the CRM, and follow up by phone and text

Talk with sellers, learn why they want to sell, and agree on a price

Send purchase contracts to sellers and follow up until the contract is signed

Nurture each lead — do not give up after one call. Most deals need many follow-ups

Comp lots (check land prices) using Zillow, DealMachine, and Land Portal

Write clear notes in the CRM after every call

Send a short report at the end of every shift: calls made, contracts sent, contracts signed, hot leads



What You Need:

Land flipping or real estate wholesaling experience is preferred, but it is not required — we will train the right person. If you do have this experience, please tell us about it, it will help your application

Experience calling U.S. property owners / sellers is also a plus

Very good spoken English — sellers must understand you easily on the phone

Hardworking and disciplined — focused, consistent, honest, and on time every day, and you keep working your leads even when sellers say no

Good internet, a quiet place to work, and a good headset

Basic computer skills and fast learning with new software



Hours and Pay:

6 hours per day

2:00 PM – 8:00 PM Eastern Time (New York time) — you must work these hours

$6 USD per hour + commission on deals that close

Paid training



Apply now — we want to hire fast.



Software We Use

It is ideal if you already know how to use these tools. If you know some of them, please tell us which ones. We will train you on the rest.

Podio — our CRM. All leads live here, and you will update it every day

Smarter Contact — our texting platform, for sending and replying to seller texts

DealMachine — for finding properties, building lists, and owner contact info

Land Portal — for checking lots: value, flood zone, wetlands, and slope

Zillow — for checking sold prices and comping lots

title: Experienced E-commerce Customer Service VA – Fashion, Customer Communication,
description:
# Hiring: Experienced Shopify Customer Service Representative – Fashion E-commerce



**Industry:** E-commerce / Fashion (US Market)  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Experience:** Previous Shopify and e-commerce customer support experience required



## Important – Please Read Before Applying



We are looking for a **highly experienced e-commerce Customer Service Representative** who has previously worked with Shopify stores and understands how to handle high volumes of customer support tickets efficiently.



**Our biggest priorities are:**



- **Chargeback Prevention:** Proven experience in reducing chargebacks, resolving disputes before they escalate, and handling dissatisfied customers.

- **Refunds, Returns & Store Credit:** Experience negotiating and offering appropriate partial refunds, store credit, exchanges, and returns to resolve customer issues while protecting the business.

- **High-Volume Ticket Management:** Ability to respond to a large number of daily tickets quickly, accurately, and professionally.

- **Shopify Experience:** Strong knowledge of Shopify, including order management, tracking, refunds, cancellations, and customer information.

- **Attention to Detail & Documentation:** Every customer interaction, action taken, and unresolved issue must be properly logged and followed up on.

- **Supplier Communication:** Experience communicating with suppliers regarding out-of-stock products, shipping delays, fulfillment issues, and refunds.

- **Speed & Efficiency:** Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and keep up as the business continues growing.



**We are specifically looking for someone with previous hands-on experience in these areas, not someone who needs to learn the basics of e-commerce customer support.**



## About Us



We are a growing e-commerce business operating **multiple online fashion stores selling clothing and fashion products to customers across the United States.**



Our business is expanding every day, with increasing order volumes and customer inquiries across our stores.



We see customer service as one of the most important parts of our business operations. It is not simply about responding to
s. Good customer service directly impacts customer satisfaction, chargeback rates, profitability, and the overall success of our stores.



We are looking for someone who understands this responsibility and wants to become a valuable part of our team.



As we continue to grow, we want to build a reliable team of people who take their work seriously, care about the business, and want to grow alongside us.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Customer Support & Ticket Management

- Handle a high volume of daily customer inquiries across multiple fashion stores.

- Respond to questions regarding orders, shipping, product issues, cancellations, returns, and refunds.

- Provide clear, professional, and helpful responses to US customers.

- Work quickly while maintaining a high standard of accuracy.

- Keep detailed logs of all customer interactions, resolutions, and required follow-ups.

- Ensure unresolved tickets are properly tracked and nothing is overlooked.



### 2. Chargeback Prevention & Refund Management



**This is one of the most important responsibilities of the position.**



- Proactively resolve customer complaints before they turn into chargebacks or payment disputes.

- Understand how to handle frustrated customers and de-escalate difficult situations.

- Have previous experience offering partial refunds, store credit, exchanges, or returns as appropriate solutions.

- Know when to offer alternative resolutions and when a full refund is required under company policies and applicable customer rights.

- Work toward reducing unnecessary chargebacks and financial losses while keeping customers satisfied.

- Recognize potential dispute risks and take action early.



### 3. Shopify Order Management

- Navigate Shopify confidently and independently.

- Review order details, fulfillment statuses, tracking information, refunds, and cancellations.

- Investigate order issues and provide accurate customer updates.

- Maintain organized customer and order records.

- Work across multiple Shopify stores when needed.



### 4. Supplier Communication

- Communicate with suppliers regarding order delays, missing items, stock availability, and fulfillment problems.

- Follow up on orders that require additional attention.

- Identify out-of-stock products and coordinate cancellations, alternatives, or refunds.

- Ensure customers are informed promptly and accurately when issues arise.

- Maintain clear communication between customers, suppliers, and the internal team.



## Requirements



- Proven experience working in customer service for e-commerce businesses, preferably fashion or clothing stores.

- Strong hands-on experience with Shopify.

- Previous experience handling a high volume of customer support tickets daily.

- **Strong understanding of chargeback prevention, refund negotiations, partial refunds, store credit, and returns.**

- Excellent written English and professional communication skills.

- Extremely detail-oriented and organized.

- Ability to work quickly and efficiently without sacrificing quality.

- Previous experience communicating with suppliers and resolving fulfillment issues.

- Good problem-solving skills and the ability to make informed decisions.

- Ability to maintain accurate logs and follow up on unresolved cases.

- Reliable, responsible, and capable of working independently.



## The Type of Person We're Looking For



Experience is extremely important to us, but so is your attitude toward your work.



We want someone who:



- **Genuinely cares about the work they do** and takes pride in delivering good results.

- Understands that customer service is a vital part of the business, not just a task of replying to
s.

- Is a team player who communicates well and supports the rest of the operation.

- Takes ownership of customer issues and follows through until they are resolved.

- Pays close attention to details and understands how small mistakes can affect the business.

- Can adapt quickly, work at a fast pace, and handle increasing responsibilities.

- Is proactive and identifies problems before they become bigger issues.

- Wants to build a long-term working relationship and grow with the company.



We are growing quickly and value people who can keep up with that growth while maintaining high standards.



## Long-Term Growth Opportunity



We are not simply looking to fill a temporary position.



We want to find someone who can become a **long-term, valuable member of our team** and play an important role in our daily operations.



As our business expands and we continue adding more stores, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibilities and potentially move into customer service leadership or management positions.



We want someone who feels invested in the company's success and understands that their contribution genuinely matters.



## How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. **Your previous e-commerce customer service experience**, including what types of stores you worked for.

2. Your experience using Shopify and any customer support platforms.

3. **Your experience reducing chargebacks and handling partial refunds, store credit, and returns.** Please provide an example of how you successfully resolved a difficult customer situation.

4. Approximately how many customer support tickets you have handled per day in previous roles.

5. Your experience communicating with suppliers and handling shipping or stock-related issues.

6. Your expected hourly rate in USD and your availability.



**Please note:** We are prioritizing candidates with genuine, hands-on e-commerce customer support experience. Generic applications that do not address the requirements above will not be prioritized.



We look forward to finding someone who is experienced, motivated, detail-oriented, and ready to grow with our business.

title: Financial Coordinator
description:
The Company

At Buffer Insurance, we believe the most meaningful impact we make is in the lives of others. That's why protecting our clients and ensuring their future impact is our highest priority. By making insurance simple, comprehensive, and cost-effective, we are able to earn our clients' trust and help them stay focused on their life and business goals.



Culture

At Buffer, we seek to build and nurture a culture for our organization that produces and protects a God-honoring atmosphere. We lay the foundation for this cultural expression by personally living out Buffer’s values and instilling them in all who work alongside us on our staff. Our values can be summarized in five words: excellence, teamwork, health, growth, and trust. By upholding these values, we can better serve our clients through our vision, mission, and purpose.



Role Summary

The Financial Coordinator’s role is vital to supporting the company's internal operations and assisting the Leadership team in maximizing its growth through sound financial decision-making.



Some of this role's tasks include providing financial reports to the leadership team, managing accounts payable and receivable, and reconciling financial statements. Throughout all of these interactions, the Accounting & Payroll Coordinator must maintain a high level of professionalism and seek to grow their knowledge in general accounting practices.



The Accountant & Payroll Coordinator will also assist with annual budgeting and forecasting, and will work closely with the leadership team to ensure the financial health of the organization. This position is also responsible for processing payroll semi-monthly in a timely and accurate manner.



Success in this role includes assisting the Administrative team, taking off responsibilities off team member's plate so their focus can remain on growing the Company's impact.



Duties, Tasks and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Manage accounts payable and receivable, including processing invoices, reconciling vendor statements

• Prepare and reconcile bank and credit card statements monthly

• Assist with budgeting and forecasting, including creating financial projections and tracking actual results

• Prepare financial reports for management and clients, including monthly profit and loss statements and balance sheets

• Maintain accurate financial records, including tracking expenses and revenues

• Work with management team to identify areas for financial improvement and recommend solutions

• Provide support for audit preparation and assist with tax return preparation

• Reconcile revenue reports with client accounts

• Process payroll semi-monthly

• Working during U.S. Hours 8am and 5pm Central Standard Time



Skills and Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in business finance, accounting, or a related field

• 3-5 years experience in Bookkeeping and Payroll

title: Operations Manager

Core Group Company (CGC)

About Core Group Company

Core Group Company (CGC) is a U.S.-based technology consulting firm specializing in ERP implementation, business process optimization, software development, and technology solutions. We help businesses streamline operations, improve efficiency, and maximize the value of their technology investments.



As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Operations Manager who can bring structure, accountability, and operational excellence to our team.







About the Role

We are seeking a proactive, organized, and results-driven Operations Manager to oversee daily operations, coordinate project delivery, manage resources, support our sales team, and ensure smooth collaboration across teams.



This is a 3rd shift, full-time role designed to cover U.S. business hours from the Philippines. You will work closely with executive leadership, our Account Executive, project teams, functional consultants, and developers to ensure operational priorities are clearly defined, projects remain on track, and commitments are consistently followed through.



The ideal candidate brings strong experience in operations management, project coordination, team leadership, sales operations support, and process improvement -- preferably within a technology consulting, software development, or ERP implementation environment.



This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can manage multiple priorities, maintain operational visibility, and drive continuous improvement.







Key Responsibilities

Operations & Team Management



Facilitate daily operational standup meetings and monitor progress, priorities, and blockers.

Maintain established operating procedures and recurring meeting schedules.

Project & Task Management

Identify overdue tasks, delivery risks, and resource constraints.

Collaborate with account management and technical teams on client requirements.

Escalate unresolved client issues to leadership.

Schedule discovery and follow-up calls; send confirmations and reminders to prospects.

Prepare proposal and SOW drafts from CGC templates for the Account Executive to finalize.

Manage the lead nurture queue and flag stalled or overdue opportunities weekly.

Reporting & Performance Monitoring



Prepare weekly operational reports, leadership meeting agendas, and project status summaries.

Monitor key metrics including team utilization, capacity, and project performance.

Track operational risks, outstanding deliverables, and improvement opportunities.

Ensure recurring administrative reviews are completed accurately and on time.

Systems & Process Improvement



Coordinate internal systems projects and operational improvement initiatives.

Maintain and improve workflows across ERP, CRM, project management, and collaboration platforms.

Monitor lead management and business automation workflows.

Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Coordinate Microsoft 365 license audits and administrative reviews.

Recruitment & Administrative Support



Support recruitment activities including candidate tracking and interview coordination.

Coordinate employee onboarding, Odoo profile setup, and system access requests.

Maintain organizational charts and employee documentation.

Monitor designated
 accounts and handle recurring administrative tasks.

Qualifications

Required



Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.

At least 5 years of experience in operations management, project management, or service delivery.

Experience coordinating remote teams and managing multiple projects simultaneously.

Hands-on experience with Jira, Asana, Monday, or a similar project management tool.

Experience with CRM, ERP, or business management systems.

Experience supporting sales operations -- CRM pipeline hygiene, scheduling, lead nurturing, and proposal preparation.

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Experience developing SOPs and improving operational processes.

Experience with ERP systems; hands-on Odoo implementation experience (functional configuration, go-lives, or client training) is strongly preferred.

Willingness to pursue and obtain Odoo Functional Consultant certification if not already certified.

Willingness and availability to work 3rd shift -- U.S. night hours (approx. 10 PM - 7 AM PHT).

Preferred



Experience in technology consulting, software development, ERP implementation, or managed services.

Hands-on Odoo ERP implementation experience (functional configuration, go-lives, or client training) -- this is a strong differentiator.

Odoo Functional Consultant certification, or active commitment to obtaining it within the first year.

Experience with Jira and Confluence.

Knowledge of Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and collaboration tools.

Experience monitoring team utilization, capacity, and operational KPIs.

Experience with CRM automation and marketing automation tools (e.g., Odoo CRM / Marketing Automation).

Familiarity with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS).

What Success Looks Like

Become familiar with Odoo, Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft 365 workflows.

Establish working relationships with leadership and team members.

First 60 Days -- Operational Ownership

Own CRM hygiene and sales scheduling for the Account Executive.

Maintain accurate task tracking, resource monitoring, and operational reporting.

Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

First 90 Days -- Process Optimization



Demonstrate consistent ownership of assigned operational responsibilities.

Maintain clear visibility into project progress, resource availability, and business priorities.

Implement approved improvements to workflows and processes.

Why Join Core Group Company?

Work fully remotely with a U.S.-based technology consulting company.

Collaborate with experienced professionals across business and technology functions.

Gain exposure to ERP implementations, software development, sales operations, and business automation.

Take on a role with meaningful responsibility and direct impact on company operations.

Competitive hourly compensation: P700 - P1,000 per hour based on experience (approx. ₱120,000 – ₱175,000 per month at 40 hrs/week).



How to Apply

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit:





An updated resume.

A brief summary (3-5 sentences) of your most relevant operations management and sales support experience.

Confirmation of your availability to work 3rd shift (approx. 10 PM - 7 AM PHT; 7 AM - 4 PM MT in winter, 8 AM - 5 PM MT in summer).

title: UGC & AI Voiceover Ads Video Editor (Advanced English Required)
description:
We're looking for a skilled video editor who specializes in creating engaging UGC-style ads and AI voiceover-based video ads for
 and Instagram.



This is not a general video editing role. We're specifically looking for someone who understands how to edit short-form advertisements that capture attention, maintain viewer engagement, and feel natural to the feed.



Exceptional English comprehension is essential for this position. You need to understand natural English speech, tonality, pacing, emotional emphasis, and how to make AI-generated voiceovers sound like real people.



What You'll Be Doing



1. UGC Video Ad Editing



You'll take raw footage from content creators and turn it into engaging, natural-looking social media advertisements.



Cut and arrange footage to match provided ad scripts.



Select the best takes and remove unnecessary pauses or filler.



Add captions, B-roll, and sound effects where appropriate / whenever instructed.



Create smooth, natural pacing that keeps viewers engaged.



Make ads feel authentic rather than overly edited.



We're not looking for crazy transitions or excessive effects. We want clean, intentional editing that makes the content engaging and easy to follow.



2. AI Voiceover Ad Creation (ElevenLabs)



You'll also be creating more polished video ads using AI-generated voiceovers.



Generate natural-sounding English voiceovers using ElevenLabs.



Adjust pacing, pauses, emphasis, and emotional delivery to match the script.



Identify and fix robotic or unnatural-sounding speech.



Build engaging video ads around the voiceovers using relevant footage, B-roll, captions, graphics, and sound effects.



Ensure the visuals, voiceover, and script work together seamlessly.



We're not looking for someone who simply generates a voiceover and uses the first result. You need to have a good ear for what sounds natural and know how to improve the delivery.



What We're Looking For



Excellent English Comprehension (Non-Negotiable)



This is arguably the most important requirement for this role.



You must have an advanced understanding of spoken English, including conversational tone, natural pronunciation, sentence rhythm, emotional delivery, and word emphasis.



You should be able to listen to a voiceover and immediately recognize when something sounds unnatural, even if the words are technically correct.



Strong Short-Form Ad Editing Skills



Experience editing UGC-style content and social media advertisements.



Understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention.



Ability to follow scripts accurately and create videos that flow naturally.



Strong attention to detail when selecting footage, timing cuts, and matching visuals to dialogue.



AI Voiceover Experience



Experience with ElevenLabs is highly preferred, particularly if you've worked with AI-generated voiceovers for advertising.



Reliability & Communication



Ability to follow instructions and implement feedback.



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.



Consistent communication and ability to meet deadlines.



Willingness to learn and improve over time.



A Quick Question Before You Continue



We value attention to detail and want to work with people who take the time to understand instructions.



When submitting your application, please tell us what your favourite local Filipino meal is and why you like it.



Include your answer at the very start of your application.



Who This Role Is NOT For



This position probably isn't a good fit if:



Your experience is primarily gaming montages, cinematic edits, or long-form YouTube videos.



You rely heavily on flashy transitions rather than clean storytelling and pacing.



You struggle to recognize unnatural English speech or awkward AI voiceovers.



You have little experience working with short-form social media content.



You prefer to improvise rather than closely follow provided scripts.



How to Apply

ElevenLabs: Tell us whether you've used ElevenLabs or similar AI voiceover tools before.

title: Create AI Thumbnails for YouTube
description:
# We're Hiring: AI YouTube Thumbnail Designer



We are a growing YouTube media company managing multiple channels across very different niches, including boats, engines, infrastructure, engineering, and many more.



We're looking for an **AI Thumbnail Designer with exceptional adaptability, a highly critical visual eye, and an excellent command of English.**



Our thumbnails are primarily created using ChatGPT's image generation capabilities and then refined using any simple image-editing software.



**WE DO NOT ACCEPT GENERIC, LOW-EFFORT AI-GENERATED THUMBNAILS.**



We don't want someone who simply follows templates or uses the same visual style for every project.



We need someone capable of learning new visual styles quickly, adapting to completely different audiences, and constantly improving the quality of their work.



**A very high level of English is essential for this position.** You must be able to understand complex video titles, detailed instructions, subtle meanings, and feedback naturally and accurately.



## What Matters Most to Us



**1. EXTREME ADAPTABILITY**



This is our number one priority.



You'll work across many YouTube channels with completely different audiences and visual identities.



One day, you might create an ultra-realistic thumbnail featuring massive boat engines. The next, you might work on an infrastructure video requiring maps or an entirely different visual approach.



We need someone who can:



- Learn unfamiliar visual styles quickly.

- Understand what works for different audiences.

- Adapt to new niches without relying on one specific design formula.

- Accept feedback and immediately apply what they've learned.

- Continuously evolve their approach as our channels develop.



**2. EXCEPTIONAL VISUAL JUDGMENT**



We need someone with a strong critical eye.



You must be able to identify when an image looks artificial, unconvincing, poorly composed, confusing, or simply not impactful enough.



You should be capable of recognizing problems and improving the result independently, without needing detailed instructions for every correction.



**3. CREATIVITY**



Creativity still matters, but we value the ability to understand, adapt, and execute different styles more than producing completely original concepts every time.



We want thoughtful visual decisions, not creativity for its own sake.



## Your Responsibilities



- Generate high-quality, ultra-realistic AI images using ChatGPT.

- Design compelling YouTube thumbnails across multiple niches.

- Learn and reproduce different visual styles while adapting them to new subjects.

- Use any simple image-editing software for occasional minor adjustments.

- Make small corrections to AI-generated imperfections when needed.

- Add simple text, arrows, labels, or visual elements when appropriate.

- Revise thumbnails based on feedback and apply those lessons to future projects.



**Important:** Most of the visual work will be done directly through ChatGPT image generation. Advanced Photoshop skills or complex manual image manipulation are NOT required. We only expect basic editing abilities for very small finishing touches.



## Requirements



- Experience generating images with ChatGPT or comparable AI tools.

- Ability to produce convincing, photorealistic images.

- Basic familiarity with any image-editing program, such as Canva, Photopea, GIMP, or similar.

- Excellent visual judgment and attention to detail.

- Outstanding adaptability and willingness to learn.

- Understanding of composition, contrast, typography, and visual storytelling.

- Ability to work independently and follow instructions.

- **Advanced English proficiency (B2-C1 level or equivalent) — REQUIRED.**

- **Strong reading comprehension and written communication in English. You must understand nuanced titles, complex instructions, and detailed feedback without relying on translation tools.**

- Reliable communication and interest in long-term collaboration.



Previous experience designing YouTube thumbnails is welcome but **not mandatory**.



We value potential, adaptability, and visual judgment over years of experience.



## What We Offer



- Long-term remote collaboration.

- Flexible working hours.

- Work across a wide variety of YouTube niches.

- Clear guidance and feedback.

- Opportunities to develop your skills as our channels grow.

- **Compensation: $1 USD per completed thumbnail, including minor image adjustments.**



## HOW TO APPLY: DISC Assessment



Please include your DISC assessment results (Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, Compliance).



We are not expecting you to already know our visual styles. We will provide guidance and help you understand our channels.



What we're looking for is someone who can learn quickly, adapt exceptionally well, recognize visual weaknesses, and consistently improve their work.



Start your application with the word **ADAPTABLE** so we know you've read the entire description.



We're looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Executive and Operations Assistant (Fluent English) for a Toronto Tutoring Company
description:
ABOUT EXPLORING SCHOLAR

Exploring Scholar is a tutoring company based in Toronto, Ontario. Our weekends are our busiest time, and many of our families speak English or Mandarin. We are looking for an experienced, resourceful senior assistant to work directly with the owner and act as the central point of coordination across our teachers, staff, and operations.



THE ROLE

This is not a standard admin or call-center job. You will work side by side with the owner, take the growing to-do list off their plate, and make sure things actually get done. You will coordinate between teams, follow up on open items, and keep everything moving. You will not be the main person answering every parent call or booking every class, but you will be the person who keeps it all connected.



This is a senior role. Over time you will take full ownership of key parts of the company's operations that the owner currently runs personally, and you will be accountable for the results. We are looking for someone who has done this before and wants real responsibility, not someone who waits to be told what to do.



You do not need to speak Mandarin. Some of our clients and staff do, so you will use AI tools to translate and draft messages when needed, and you will be expected to do this quickly and carefully.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Act as the central coordination point between the owner, teachers, and staff

- Take ownership of key operational areas, run them end to end, and report results to the owner, with the scope growing as you prove yourself

- Turn the owner's instructions into a clear, prioritized to-do list, then work through it one task at a time

- Execute on tasks quickly and correctly, with minimal follow-up needed

- Write clear SOPs (standard operating procedures) from the instructions and examples the owner gives you

- Support teacher recruitment and onboarding

- Use AI tools to translate and write messages for Mandarin-speaking families and staff, check them for accuracy and tone, and flag anything sensitive or unclear before sending

- Step in on phone, WeChat, and scheduling tasks when the owner needs support

- Keep shared documents, trackers, and records organized in Google Workspace



MUST HAVES

- Fluent spoken and written English at a native or near-native level. This is essential, and you will be assessed on it, including on the phone.

- Very proficient with AI tools in your everyday work, including for translation, writing, and research. You must be able to tell us your skill level and give real examples.

- Resourceful. You work out how to get things done without being told how, and small obstacles do not stop you. You try more than one approach before asking for help, and when you do ask, you bring a proposed solution.

- At least 5 years of experience in executive assistant, operations, or operations management roles, with a track record of independently owning and running key processes or functions without close supervision

- Fast learner who picks up new tools and processes quickly

- Able to juggle many tasks at once and coordinate multiple people without dropping details

- Strong written communication, and able to document processes clearly

- Comfortable with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar, Drive)

- Comfortable on the phone and willing to learn WeChat

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a computer, and a headset, with a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Available during the coverage hours listed below



NICE TO HAVES

- Experience working overnight shifts and weekend shifts

- Any Mandarin ability (a bonus, not a requirement)

- Experience in education, tutoring, or a service business

- Experience with bilingual or Chinese-language customer support

- Experience building SOPs or training materials



SCHEDULE

- Full-time engagement, about 8 billable hours per day

- 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Toronto time (hours follow Toronto's clock, including daylight saving changes), with a one-hour unpaid break

- Flexible off days during weekdays. Weekends Eastern Time are busy and are mandatory work days.

- This is an overnight shift in the Philippines, so please only apply if this works for you long term



TOOLS YOU WILL USE

Our phone system, WeChat, our custom scheduling software, and Google Workspace. We will train you on everything except Google Workspace, which you should already know.



COMPENSATION

- Monthly rate of CAD $2,000 to $2,500 (CANADIAN dollars, not US dollars)

- Where you land in this range depends on how much ownership you have taken in past roles and how much you can contribute without intervention or supervision. The more independently you can run key parts of operations, the higher the pay.

- Paid monthly through Wise, at the beginning of the following month for the full previous calendar month

- A 13th month payment after one full year of working together



ENGAGEMENT TYPE

This is an independent contractor engagement under a written service agreement. You are responsible for your own taxes and registrations, you provide your own computer, headset, and internet, and you send a simple invoice each month.



You will have access to student and family information, so confidentiality and careful handling of that data are required and covered in the agreement.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, please send all of the following. Applications without these will not be reviewed.



1. Your resume, showing your years of experience and the responsibilities you owned, and a short note on why you fit this role

2. A Loom video (or any video hosting link) in which you: introduce yourself in English; describe your comfort level with AI tools (beginner, intermediate, or advanced), the tools you use, and one specific time AI dramatically increased your efficiency at work; describe the biggest area of responsibility you have owned independently in a past role and the results you delivered, plus a time you hit a roadblock and worked it out on your own; and confirm you can work 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Toronto time, including weekends.

3. Your expected monthly rate in Canadian or US dollars



Start your application with the word "Scholar" so we know you read the whole post.



HIRING PROCESS



1. Stage 1, application review: applications missing the keyword or the video are not reviewed.

2. Stage 2, practical 10-minute task

3. Stage 3, live interview: the top candidates have a video interview in English

And one more thing...



SCREEN SHARING DURING WORKING HOURS IS MANDATORY.



If you're not comfortable sharing your work screen throughout your scheduled working hours, please don't apply.



Still reading? Excellent! You're already ahead of some of our previous applicants! 😂



ABOUT THE POSITION



We are an Australian-based business developing a premium religious art and home décor brand.



We're looking for a creative, reliable and experienced person to help us build and manage Shopify websites, create advertising campaigns and produce professional marketing content using Photoshop and the latest AI tools.

This is a long-term, full-time opportunity with genuine room to grow.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Build and set up Shopify websites from start to finish.



Manage products, collections, pricing, shipping and website layouts.



Work confidently within the Shopify administration backend.

Upload products, descriptions, images and promotional content.



2. AI-Generated Product Reels & Videos – VERY IMPORTANT



We need someone who can take a single static photograph of one of our framed artworks and turn it into a realistic, professional advertising reel.



For example:



We send you a photograph of a framed religious artwork.



You use AI tools to create a realistic person standing inside a beautifully furnished home.



The person introduces the artwork, talks naturally about its beauty, quality and features, and showcases the frame.



The video then shows the person holding the framed artwork, positioning it and hanging it on the wall in their home.



The finished reel should make the artwork look like a real product being professionally demonstrated in a real home.



You must be able to:

Create AI-generated people who speak naturally and convincingly.



Generate realistic voiceovers, lip-syncing and movement.



Show people holding, presenting and hanging our framed artwork.

Produce professional reels for
, Instagram, TikTok and other advertising platforms.

We don't just want someone who can make a slideshow with music. We want someone who can bring a product to life using AI!



3. Advertising & Social Media Marketing



Create professional advertisements for
, Instagram, TikTok and Google.



Set up and manage paid advertising campaigns.



Produce promotional videos, product advertisements and marketing graphics.



Monitor advertising performance and make improvements.



Develop creative marketing ideas to promote our products.



4. AI Tools & Content Creation



Use Zeely AI, ChatGPT, Grok, Canva and other AI platforms.



Create product images, advertising videos and social media content.



Use AI video-generation tools to produce realistic people, environments and product demonstrations.



Combine AI-generated content with professional editing tools.



Research and implement new AI tools to improve our marketing.



5. Adobe Photoshop



Create and edit professional product images and advertisements.



Work confidently with layers, masks and editable PSD files.



Remove backgrounds, adjust colours and enhance images.



Prepare high-quality artwork for websites and advertising.



WHAT WE REQUIRE



Fluent spoken and written English – essential.



Minimum 2 years of relevant experience.



Genuine experience building and managing Shopify websites.



Ability to create realistic AI-generated product videos and reels.



Experience creating and running digital advertising campaigns.



Strong Adobe Photoshop skills, including layers.

Experience using Canva, Zeely or similar AI tools.

Excellent communication and attention to detail.



A positive attitude and willingness to learn.



Comfortable demonstrating your work live during a Zoom interview.



You don't need to be an expert in every AI platform. We're happy to work with someone who has genuine skills, is willing to learn and can demonstrate what they know.



WORKING HOURS & SCREEN SHARING



Monday to Friday: 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Philippine Time



40 working hours per week.



We work closely with our team throughout the day.



You MUST be comfortable sharing your work screen throughout your scheduled working hours.

Screen sharing relates to work activities during scheduled working hours.

We are trusting you with our business, our products, our Shopify stores, our sales information, our social media accounts, our advertising platforms and access to important company systems.
